subject: They hate us because we are winning.
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61988823:JAirslGXN:m:1:3371220873:B444BC649FFC4FA4F973BA71EFA6B3C4:r)
Special message from Candace Owens

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61988823:JAirslGXN:m:1:3371220873:B444BC649FFC4FA4F973BA71EFA6B3C4:r)

Peter,

I'm sure you're getting many emails today asking for donations because it's Giving Tuesday.

But I'm not emailing you just because it's Giving Tuesday. I don't want you to think that BLEXIT takes your support for granted. Our mission at BLEXIT is critical; it takes a community to achieve it and you are a critical part of our community.

The media is attacking us non-stop because we are breaking free from the victimhood mentality perpetuated in Black and urban communities.

**They hate us because we are winning. **

Just wearing a _**White Lives Matter**_ shirt brought more attention to the issues of crime and high abortion rates in Black communities than Michelle Obama did as First Lady.

**I aim to raise $200,000 before the end of the year to support BLEXIT chapters, the fight against Critical Race Theory (CRT), and BLEXIT 's educational programming including the Student Movement on college campuses.**

**Peter, I 'm not asking you to donate simply because it's Giving Tuesday. [**_I am asking you to support our mission at this critical time to prepare for 2023. Can you chip in any amount today? Click here >>>_**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61988823:JAirslGXN:m:1:3371220873:B444BC649FFC4FA4F973BA71EFA6B3C4:r)**

Here's how your donation helps BLEXIT change the narrative in Black and urban communities.

**BLEXIT Chapters**

Our state chapters are the hands and feet of the BLEXIT Foundation.

**Our 14,000 volunteers and 43 state chapters engage with the communities other organizations have abandoned. **

BLEXIT State Chapters provide resources and opportunities to create long-term success for those around them. Through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events, BLEXIT State Chapters spread the universal principles of the movement at the local, grassroots level.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61988823:JAirslGXN:m:1:3371220873:B444BC649FFC4FA4F973BA71EFA6B3C4:r)

Our values are pro-Freedom, pro-Faith, and pro-Family! We are destroying the victimhood mentality and our chapters play a key role in this mission.

[_**Help support BLEXIT 's State Chapters by giving today >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61988823:JAirslGXN:m:1:3371220873:B444BC649FFC4FA4F973BA71EFA6B3C4:r)

**BLEXIT Educational Resources**

We know the rise of Critical Race Theory (CRT) has some families concerned and with good reason.

So we put together a guide against CRT for parents, grandparents, and teachers. This resource encourages you to think critically about CRT, including how to spot it and what you can do to fight it.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61988823:JAirslGXN:m:1:3371220873:B444BC649FFC4FA4F973BA71EFA6B3C4:r)

We also created a Candidate Guide for the mid-term elections to help people make informed decisions and vote for the candidate that best represented their values and interests.

Peter, your gift today helps us educate people so they can take control of their futures.

[_**Can you support BLEXIT 's educational efforts with a gift today? Click here to send a gift of any amount >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61988823:JAirslGXN:m:1:3371220873:B444BC649FFC4FA4F973BA71EFA6B3C4:r)

**BLEXIT Student Movement**

**The BLEXIT Student Movement** is working to make an effectual change in minority communities, one campus at a time!

The goal for these clubs is to bring BLEXIT's message to historically Black universities and colleges through events and outreach efforts.

The vision and heart behind the BLEXIT Student Movement are to showcase excellence and honor the rich history and legacy created by these academic institutions, their founders, and their students at HBCUs and non-HBCUs alike.

_I know many organizations are asking for your support. What we are doing at BLEXIT is unlike any other organization. We are promoting pro-Family, pro-Faith, and pro-Freedom values in Black and urban communities_.

**Please rush your support today. I am counting on your support to raise $200,000 before the new year. **

BLEXIT Educational Resources We know the rise of Critical Race Theory (CRT) has some families concerned and with good reason. So we put together a guide against CRT for parents, grandparents, and teachers. This resource encourages you to think critically about CRT, including how to spot it and what you can do to fight it. We also created a Candidate Guide for the mid-term elections to help people make informed decisions and vote for the candidate that best represented their values and interests. Peter, your gift today helps us educate people so they can take control of their futures. BLEXIT Student Movement The BLEXIT Student Movement is working to make an effectual change in minority communities, one campus at a time! The goal for these clubs is to bring BLEXIT's message to historically Black universities and colleges through events and outreach efforts. The vision and heart behind the BLEXIT Student Movement are to showcase excellence and honor the rich history and legacy created by these academic institutions, their founders, and their students at HBCUs and non-HBCUs alike. I know many organizations are asking for your support. What we are doing at BLEXIT is unlike any other organization. We are promoting pro-Family, pro-Faith, and pro-Freedom values in Black and urban communities. Please rush your support today. I am counting on your support to raise $200,000 before the new year. Thank you, Candace Owens Co-Founder & President BLEXIT Foundation BLEXIT is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization. All contributions are tax-deductible to the extent provided by law. We’re getting closer to our goal of raising $10,000! **[Please make your gift if you haven’t yet!](https://www.bampac.org/givingtuesday?info=2022EA1003&recruiter_id=63052&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022ea1004&n=1)** Time is running out!

Dear Peter,
It’s **GIVING TUESDAY**!
This is YOUR OPPORUNITY to help BAMPAC Action Fund shore up the funds we need to give us a head start in the upcoming campaign season!
We’re seeking to raise $10,000 by the end of the day Peter. Can I count on you?
Peter, the Democrats have already hit the ground running with their appeals for money. They know they can rely on their pals in Hollywood and Silicon Valley and on socialists like billionaire George Soros to fill their coffers.
They’ll stop at nothing to destroy America and the Republican Party with their lie that the Republican Party is racist!
They know it’s not true, Peter. But they also know that if they don’t sell this outright falsehood to their supporters, then they’ll lose their power for good.
**In fact, they know if they lose** **just 12%** **of the Black vote nationwide, it'll be** **mathematically impossible** **for them to ever win another election!**
That’s why they’ll stop at nothing to publish their lies to black voters across the country - and it’s why you MUST stand shoulder to shoulder with BAMPAC Action Fund to fight back... starting with **GIVING TUESDAY**!
Peter, your generous gift today will help do three key things:
* **EXPOSE** the Liberal Lies to the entire nation.
* **RECLAIM** Black voters to the Republican Party.
* **END** the Democrats' death-grip on the Black Community.

Not only that, but your support will also help BAMPAC Action Fund purchase radio ads in urban markets across America and put up billboards in areas with high concentrations of Black Americans.
[](https://www.bampac.org/givingtuesday?info=2022EA1003&recruiter_id=63052&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022ea1004&n=4)
---

But I need your help to do it.
**[Please open your heart and wallet today during GIVING TUESDAY by chipping in a generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or $500.](https://www.bampac.org/givingtuesday?info=2022EA1003&recruiter_id=63052&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022ea1004&n=5)**

But I need your help to raise another $500,000 before our end-of-month deadline so we can keep our TV ads on the air and fund our critical get-out-the-vote efforts.

**But before I ask you to make a grassroots contribution, I'd like to tell you a story about a very special voter: My mom.
** As a Black teenager growing up in Waycross, GA, in the 1950s, my mom used to pick somebody else's cotton. She raised 12 boys and girls in public housing on the west side of Savannah. And while money was short, Mom's love was always long – she was always telling us we could do anything we put our mind to.
**Just the other day, those 84-year-old hands that used to pick somebody else's cotton again picked her son to be a U.S. Senator from Georgia. May God bless you, Mom.**
Thanks to Georgians just like my mom, we are on the cusp of winning this runoff election _and_ expanding our Senate majority. [**A grassroots contribution from you during this make-or-break moment will once again make what Mom and I never could have dreamed of become a reality. Can I count on your support?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/55302122/381283322/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5106-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YThjYjQ2MC00YTcwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNTg1OGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7n4Phlveb2ynqACe73H1KQsmokCugkmdDx_EycA3Vlw=)
The final tally from the general election shows we can win; we led Walker by a razor-thin margin. But here's the problem: National Republicans are going all-in to defeat me, and GOP donors are flooding Walker's campaign with over _$58 million_.

Hitting our grassroots fundraising goals is the only way we'll be able to fight back, keep up our momentum, and win. And I don't take a cent from corporate PACs, so truly, friend, I'm counting on your grassroots support.
[**Will you rush a donation of $5 or more now to fuel our essential runoff get-out-the-vote efforts, keep Georgia blue, and expand Democrats' Senate majority?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/55302123/381283323/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5106-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YThjYjQ2MC00YTcwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNTg1OGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7n4Phlveb2ynqACe73H1KQsmokCugkmdDx_EycA3Vlw=)

Fellow American,

By now you know Herschel Walker is in the fight of his life. He's gearing up to face off against the socialist Democrat, Raphael Warnock, in a December 6th Senate runoff that will determine the extent to which Democrats have control over the Senate.

I think a lot of folks, yourself included perhaps, may be thinking that this race isn't important given that Democrats have 50 votes plus Kamala Harris' tie-breaking vote - effectively giving them control of the Senate. If you're in this mindset, then you're the audience I'm hoping to reach today. This race isn't over, and it would be extremely bad form to leave Herschel Walker on the field, alone, in the final hours of his race.

Disclaimer: **[At the end of this email, I'm going to ask you to chip-in $5 to help keep Herschel's campaign funded through December 6th.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0e0a3539b0524148b0bcde75fd889731&_e=loXUTuhs4BRku9oGApw30PLLNYwY1IN0oSU5N7EO8t_6XCAVReeRwuZJiv4-AT787JryBryPSsgM_MaCqwIZCRDIWbTCuOKENnIYEqiKHkGUKkH32v4v-pjSB_umB_Q3jH-4Bp7wAqfayPFJwcgtYr2Ft1Ms5n0vjrN14v5r9aQBtrzDoL3qkTTy958OYTHnJFqMvjwsUI4EKQXAxsPVnb8P236J2dBaS5kiwkslwHJZO7t6HJ5WwCTQ4iqRKDdCzzhx47UktrZy9PuH5vxpFySpqpzJXYH-wwVkajxabN07BNIr2xaZqTlxw83vP3J3hJZ8B1Bqgys4WAT16jPjeHBD-dQnbrMqsAr_VC1v0zoWugQTJeaq3XJcQzFXi9vX2tYy2WAwA_40JI9cqOnCrb6ycuwptXKLp1HMC2VByeyUweq4hWDtg-Rn22_16WNSBSGByxnMD4FSwTixJAJ8Lg%3D%3D)** But first, I'm going to give you five reasons why your donation is needed now more than ever.
1. **_Absences_** : Absences in the Senate happen from time to time, due to health reasons or otherwise. If we can get Herschel elected, Republicans and Dems will each have 50 seats - leaving Democrats with no margin for error. If a Democrat is out sick with the flu and cannot vote, Dems cannot pass legislation. **If Herschel loses, Dems have a cushion.**
2. **_2024_** : The 2024 map for Democrats is tough. If Herschel wins on December 6th, Republicans start the 2024 cycle from a position of strength. If we have 50 seats going into 2024, we can devote even more resources to West Virginia and Montana (**both deep red states**) where Democrat senators will be seeking reelection.

[** CHIP in $5 ->**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0e0a3539b0524148b0bcde75fd889731&_e=loXUTuhs4BRku9oGApw30PLLNYwY1IN0oSU5N7EO8t_6XCAVReeRwuZJiv4-AT787JryBryPSsgM_MaCqwIZCRDIWbTCuOKENnIYEqiKHkGUKkH32v4v-pjSB_umB_Q3jH-4Bp7wAqfayPFJwcgtYr2Ft1Ms5n0vjrN14v5r9aQBtrzDoL3qkTTy958OYTHnJFqMvjwsUI4EKQXAxsPVnb8P236J2dBaS5kiwkslwHJZO7t6HJ5WwCTQ4iqRKDdCzzhx47UktrZy9PuH5vxpFySpqpzJXYH-wwVkajxabN1cE9Zn9VcV2oxJx6R_YQG3xBpYWnrliKVuLV_pqvHmJidwa8bjqSyN9oOvVE4waWX3E4v0J9xswPkKuLIKUlZh2n682ScbS2HYwOBawiVGUMARr-85lslxEOUqPM_wbfQh-gDfswk3qBj13WQFNGBhoiHXt28I7mRYDXaMmMNO7HpBWF4XVJeCxB8BD3RUsKA%3D)

3. **_Judges_** : With a 50/50 Senate, the Senate Judiciary Committee will have equal numbers of Republicans and Democrats - allowing us to force Democrats to only consider the most consequential nominations. **If Warnock wins, Democrats can confirm anyone they want.**
4. **_Federal nominations:_** With a 50/50 Senate, Republicans will have leverage over who can win confirmation to lead federal agencies. With a 50/50 Senate, we'll get less Elizabeth Warren-type nominees and more “level-headed” options to give the thumbs up or thumbs down to.
5. **_6 years:_** If Herschel Walker wins on December 6th, he'll serve for the next 6 years. If we don't get Herschel over the line, **it could have an impact on who controls the Senate for the next 6 years.** If we're at 49/51, it will be that much harder to win back the Senate in 2024 and retain it in 2026 and 2028.

**We simply cannot afford to lose this race.** We all hoped for a different outcome on November 8th. But wishing for a different outcome while we still have a chance on December 6th would be foolhardy. **[That's why I'm asking you to chip in $5 today.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0e0a3539b0524148b0bcde75fd889731&_e=loXUTuhs4BRku9oGApw30PLLNYwY1IN0oSU5N7EO8t_6XCAVReeRwuZJiv4-AT787JryBryPSsgM_MaCqwIZCRDIWbTCuOKENnIYEqiKHkGUKkH32v4v-pjSB_umB_Q3jH-4Bp7wAqfayPFJwcgtYr2Ft1Ms5n0vjrN14v5r9aQBtrzDoL3qkTTy958OYTHnJFqMvjwsUI4EKQXAxsPVnb8P236J2dBaS5kiwkslwHJZO7t6HJ5WwCTQ4iqRKDdCzzhx47UktrZy9PuH5vxpFySpqpzJXYH-wwVkajxabN07BNIr2xaZqTlxw83vP3J3ou9beuH3FRia3e3VtteA6HQ_-ROGgNNtbQtkWViIhQ42s19qYBL3SuL-P-l8MSo1K8El_ZuwyA82aC3L2mzRaepduBGZwOTbdAMnaNhkuj_3PywBnJGKGsEzH2IVbCmPqzAcntd6ItucqWGV3IR_CA%3D%3D)**

I think a lot of folks, yourself included perhaps, may be thinking that this race isn't important given that Democrats have 50 votes plus Kamala Harris' tie-breaking vote - effectively giving them control of the Senate. If you're in this mindset, then you're the audience I'm hoping to reach today. This race isn't over, and it would be extremely bad form to leave Herschel Walker on the field, alone, in the final hours of his race. Disclaimer: But first, I'm going to give you five reasons why your donation is needed now more than ever. 1. Absences : Absences in the Senate happen from time to time, due to health reasons or otherwise. If we can get Herschel elected, Republicans and Dems will each have 50 seats - leaving Democrats with no margin for error. If a Democrat is out sick with the flu and cannot vote, Dems cannot pass legislation. If Herschel loses, Dems have a cushion. 2. 2024 : The 2024 map for Democrats is tough. If Herschel wins on December 6th, Republicans start the 2024 cycle from a position of strength. If we have 50 seats going into 2024, we can devote even more resources to West Virginia and Montana (both deep red states) where Democrat senators will be seeking reelection. 3. Judges : With a 50/50 Senate, the Senate Judiciary Committee will have equal numbers of Republicans and Democrats - allowing us to force Democrats to only consider the most consequential nominations. If Warnock wins, Democrats can confirm anyone they want. 4. Federal nominations: With a 50/50 Senate, Republicans will have leverage over who can win confirmation to lead federal agencies. With a 50/50 Senate, we'll get less Elizabeth Warren-type nominees and more “level-headed” options to give the thumbs up or thumbs down to. 5. 6 years: If Herschel Walker wins on December 6th, he'll serve for the next 6 years. If we don't get Herschel over the line, it could have an impact on who controls the Senate for the next 6 years. If we're at 49/51, it will be that much harder to win back the Senate in 2024 and retain it in 2026 and 2028. We simply cannot afford to lose this race. We all hoped for a different outcome on November 8th. But wishing for a different outcome while we still have a chance on December 6th would be foolhardy. I want Herschel to win. The Senate needs Herschel's vote to stop Democrats from doing their darndest. You need him so we can keep America great. Thanks, Jim Jordan | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. To the People of Arizona and of the United States:

Printer problems, tabulation errors, 3-hour lines or longer, and confusing instructions given by election officials made this Election Day the most chaotic in Arizona's history.

Half of the Voting Centers that opened for the first time on Election Day (where the overwhelming majority of voters were voting for Kari Lake) were not operational or had significant failures.

Would you get on a plane if HALF of the engines didn't work? Would our friends in the media be able to broadcast their nightly propaganda if HALF of their studio equipment was not working? The 2022 General Election in Arizona was botched and broken beyond repair.

This isn't about Republicans or Democrats. This is about our sacred right to Vote, a right that many voters were, sadly, deprived of on November 8th. Tens of thousands have reached out, pleading with me to fight for them. Rest assured, I will. If we give up now, we will no longer have a Country.

Attorneys are working diligently to gather information, whistleblowers ARE coming forward, and the curtain is being lifted. Whether done accidentally or intentionally, it is clear that this Election was a debacle that destroyed any trust in our elections. Arizonans who chose to make their voice heard on Election Day shouldn't be disenfranchised or punished for choosing to vote in person. Yet they were.

I want you to know, Arizona, I will continue fighting until we restore confidence and faith in our elections.

clean_body: | To the People of Arizona and of the United States: Printer problems, tabulation errors, 3-hour lines or longer, and confusing instructions given by election officials made this Election Day the most chaotic in Arizona's history. Half of the Voting Centers that opened for the first time on Election Day (where the overwhelming majority of voters were voting for Kari Lake) were not operational or had significant failures. Would you get on a plane if HALF of the engines didn't work? Would our friends in the media be able to broadcast their nightly propaganda if HALF of their studio equipment was not working? The 2022 General Election in Arizona was botched and broken beyond repair. This isn't about Republicans or Democrats. This is about our sacred right to Vote, a right that many voters were, sadly, deprived of on November 8th. Tens of thousands have reached out, pleading with me to fight for them. Rest assured, I will. If we give up now, we will no longer have a Country. Attorneys are working diligently to gather information, whistleblowers ARE coming forward, and the curtain is being lifted. Whether done accidentally or intentionally, it is clear that this Election was a debacle that destroyed any trust in our elections. Arizonans who chose to make their voice heard on Election Day shouldn't be disenfranchised or punished for choosing to vote in person. Yet they were. I want you to know, Arizona, I will continue fighting until we restore confidence and faith in our elections. | Thank You, Kari Lake Candidate for Arizona Governor

name: Team Jayapal
subject: Urgent evening update
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
This isn’t looking too good, Peter
#
Hey Peter, it’s Team Jayapal here with an urgent update:
Earlier today, Pramila reached out to you about our goal of raising $50,000 by midnight tomorrow. But right now, our numbers are not looking good, Peter.
Raising this money is crucial as we prepare for a new Congress — especially one where Pramila’s work alongside the Progressive Caucus has NEVER been more important.
Peter, if we don’t hit this goal before midnight tomorrow, we won’t be in as strong of a position as we should be heading into December. [**Will you help us turn things around by donating $5 — or any amount that’s meaningful to you — before midnight tomorrow?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/23839?refcode=em20221129-2-1902&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1902%2E420207%2EQP9xVD)
Thank you for all you do,
— Team Jayapal
* * *
Peter,
From the moment I first launched my campaign for Congress in 2016, I have never wavered in my belief in our grassroots movement. And I know what else I believe in: outsized spending and dark money should not buy our elections.
**I don’t believe that our politics and policies should be bought, so I won’t be either.** I have never accepted a single cent from corporate PACs or dark money groups, and I never will. And I know that it only makes our movement stronger, because people power wins.
Just look at the incredible cohort of progressives I was proud to endorse this cycle — Maxwell Frost, Greg Casar, Summer Lee, Delia Ramirez, and many more — who will join me in the ranks of the Progressive Caucus as we fight every day on your behalf.
**I say this because I want to remind you that what we do now matters.** In a couple short months, our new session of Congress will begin, with Republican control of the House, but also with more progressives than ever before.
This time of the year can be challenging for campaigns, when we take stock of our resources and make sure we reach all of our goals for the year — all while fundraising declines and many of us log off for the holidays.
I’m writing to you now because I wanted to personally make a request. My team has set a goal for us to reach $50,000 by midnight tomorrow, as we close the books on November 2022.
I am not here to guilt trip you. There is no imaginary donor who will triple-match your donation, and the sky is not falling. **Just you and me, and my sincere hope that you will recognize the importance of this moment.**
[**If you are in a position to make a contribution today, I would appreciate it greatly. Please know that your support always makes a difference for us.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/23839?refcode=em20221129-2-1902&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=1902%2E420207%2EQP9xVD)
At the end of the day, every election I’ve won, every fundraising goal I’ve hit, every milestone I’ve worked with our Progressive Caucus to achieve — it all comes down to you.
Thank you for your steadfast support.
Pramila
(Sent from my iPhone)

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20221129-1902-footer&t=3&refcode2=1902_420207_QP9xVD&akid=1902%2E420207%2EQP9xVD)**

| | | Peter, this is Senator Tim Scott.

I don't mean to alarm you, but there's no better way to put this: if Herschel Walker loses the runoff race, the American Dream will be on the verge of collapsing.

I wish it wasn't true. But here are the possible realities if we lose Georgia:
❌ They will PACK the courts with Liberal justices.
❌ They will RAISE your taxes & INCREASE wasteful spending.
❌ They will block ALL legislation to SECURE our border.
It would be a total disaster. But that's exactly what will happen under Chuck Schumer and his radical crony, Raphael Warnock.

I'm praying and hoping that doesn't happen. **But even in times of prayer comes a call to action.**

**[That's why I'm hoping to rally the support of 25,000 patriots before midnight to back conservative champion Herschel Walker, in his all-or-nothing bid to secure Georgia for Republicans.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61991413:JSOkmlGNE:m:1:3317145305:2DE68219C2DADDC937DC79A6C6D8FDAF:r "That’s why I’m hoping to rally the support of 25,000 patriots before midnight to
back conservative champion Herschel Walker, in his all-or-nothing bid to secure Georgia for Republicans.")**

Just as we learned the hard way in the 2020 Georgia run-off election, these seats aren't won for free.

subject: Peter, he deserved a Pulitzer, instead he was charged with 9 felonies
body:
Dear Peter, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he's been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61991377:JJJymlGN5:m:1:3331703221:777BB101D0CD2A0B055E341DF9F7759B:r)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now Vice-President Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61991377:JJJymlGN5:m:1:3331703221:777BB101D0CD2A0B055E341DF9F7759B:r)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61991377:JJJymlGN5:m:1:3331703221:777BB101D0CD2A0B055E341DF9F7759B:r)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood's nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We're fighting back, but we'll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment, they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61991377:JJJymlGN5:m:1:3331703221:777BB101D0CD2A0B055E341DF9F7759B:r)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate to stand with David Daleiden today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61991377:JJJymlGN5:m:1:3331703221:777BB101D0CD2A0B055E341DF9F7759B:r)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel P.S. Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. Can I count on you to support the official criminal defense of David Daleiden? **[David is a pro-life hero. Will you make a generous donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to stop this attempt to crush him?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61991377:JJJymlGN5:m:1:3331703221:777BB101D0CD2A0B055E341DF9F7759B:r)** [**DONATE**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61991377:JJJymlGN5:m:1:3331703221:777BB101D0CD2A0B055E341DF9F7759B:r) [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61991377:JJJymlGN5:m:1:3331703221:777BB101D0CD2A0B055E341DF9F7759B:r) The Thomas More Society is a not-for-profit, national public interest law firm dedicated to restoring respect in law for life, family, and religious liberty. Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c84270%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XpPc%2b5NTkfWugKHi0PSooQ&sysid=1)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c84270%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XpPc%2b5NTkfWugKHi0PSooQ&sysid=1)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: Have you seen what they’re doing to our kids?
body:
We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help to win... [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0109%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=dmbYxsF88%2f%2fp5tat65a6mw&sysid=1)
| | | Dear Fellow Conservative, We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help to win... [**That’s why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation of $35 or more today.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c41280%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6M8Dk67Hxxgf1nMJ0GHUlg&sysid=1) We recently filed suit against a school AND the activists pretending to be teachers to make them pay for what they’re doing to our young and vulnerable children. Because the ONLY way we’re going to stop them -- is to make these extremists pay for their crimes... And that’s exactly what our landmark lawsuit does! Let me quickly give you the details in case you missed us while we were on **Laura Ingraham** ’s great **Fox News **show talking about our case: Jessica Konen, the mother of an innocent 12-year-old girl, was called into her daughter’s school and told that her daughter was now a “boy”. She found out that her young daughter had been groomed into believing she was “transgender” and “bisexual”... Her impressionable daughter didn’t even know these words until they were forced on her by these radicals. The school then pushed Jessica’s innocent daughter to create a whole new identity -- complete with a new boy’s name, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom... They also created a “Gender Support Plan” and ordered the faculty to use her new name and pronouns -- all without her mother’s knowledge! **And Jessica had no idea because her young daughter was told NOT to tell her mother since she couldn’t be “trusted”****.**
* These people are not real teachers.
* They’re not concerned with teaching our children to read...
* They’re not concerned with teaching our children math and arithmetic...
* They’re not concerned with teaching history...

They want to indoctrinate an entire generation of children to reject their parent’s values and embrace their radical Left-Wing propaganda -- and we have to stop them. [**That’s why I’m asking you to rush in your donation of $35 or more to help us stop these child groomers now.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c41281%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vWRYr2Ddk%2b%2bhFmNOmaImpw&sysid=1) After all this, Jessica did what any good mother would do and questioned the principal about what was happening to her young daughter at school... ... And what happened next? Child Protective Services was called to her house and “interviewed” her children! This grooming is happening behind closed doors in classrooms across the country... And it’s happening in secret so parents, grandparents and the community don’t know what’s going on. Jessica’s innocent daughter is just one of the countless victims -- and if we don’t act, there will be more and more every day... Since we announced our lawsuit **The Ingraham Angle** , tons of concerned parents, grandparents and teachers have reached out to us. It’s horrible and sickening that this is happening, but we have to stop it... And our lawsuit is the key. Political pressure and new laws will not work -- we must drag these radical activists and schools into court and make them pay. That’s why our lawsuit names the individual “teachers” -- we must hold **them** accountable... Only when these extremists are scared of being dragged into court and are forced to pay will they stop. Make no mistake -- if we win this landmark case every single one of these so-called teachers will take notice. They will think of the consequences before pushing their radical agenda on our vulnerable children... [**So please, join me today with a donation of $35 or more to fund our lawsuit to protect our kids from out of control leftist teachers.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c41282%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8ti77zzMQk%2faq95xT05%2b2w&sysid=1) But to stop them, we need to win this case... And if you can give more today - $50, $100, $250 or more - I will use it to protect our children and our constitutional rights from these radical Left extremists. But, whatever amount you can send, I ask that you rush it in right away. And please know that here at the Center for American Liberty we don’t just file lawsuits - we **WIN** them!! We recently won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court and we’re fighting Big Tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives... But this case to stop these extremists from corrupting and damaging our innocent children is too important to lose. And the only way to stop them is to make them know we’re going to make them pay for their actions... [**So please, join the fight today****with your emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100 or more today.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c41283%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qbyyFrfvBr1HqLT69XVW6w&sysid=1) We’re ready to go to the mat to win this case, but we can’t do it without you. Thank you in advance for your support. Sincerely,

Harmeet K. Dhillon

body:

[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgjkf742v748ll1ndvda99fo22lgkrp9qq6cd93g_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56egn4tblm1on4t1kmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfcor2c8oj1d9gsqpb9o5gspq62odi69pn0ohks4qraob4mho68pr2mcob2clm6urt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6cooj9d9kcur6cphkcapmcdtgmlin48d245p25oh4cdhm9o70cdg6cpj24no)

| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zk0996e2j24i3sv9f1pf8vt928l13iq1te0nrdc8_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3g66o36cph2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3vsjrgh5m7nd1raha254poiled24jqsk5hdfq58_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3g66o36cph2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: Elon Musk isn't the only one defending free speech
body:
Here’s the truth: radical left wing bureaucrats are controlling colleges and universities.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze94a31b488sapkjb36c4soo23g0n5uiu0736q38_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3g66o36cph2bs)

Friend,

Here's the truth: radical left wing bureaucrats are controlling colleges and universities.

They don't care about education, only turning these areas of learning into indoctrination camps.

That's why they are so afraid of free speech -- because it lets pro-liberty students fight indoctrination.

But I have great news! **We recently won our 100th free speech victory!**

My name is Sean Themea, the Chief of Staff at Young Americans for Liberty Foundation (YAL). I'm beyond proud of our dedicated student activists fighting against authoritarianism and wokeism on their campuses.

While we've made great strides in the fight for liberty on campus, 100 free speech victories is only the beginning.

**That 's why we're targeting a new batch of campuses this January. It is our next step toward DOUBLING our goal and reaching 200 free speech victories. I want to count you in as one of our 100 new supporters to help us get there.**

[_**Friend, can you help support the Student Rights Campaign and our efforts to organize on campuses across the country by sending your first gift today? Click here to donate $10, $25, $50, or any amount >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrmgphmov8nlhvsk4kne0m09ierrgt02jvn9ep6o_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3g66o36cph2bs)

**We 've made over 1.5 MILLION students freer on campus through our fight for Free Speech!**

And these victories don't just benefit current students but every student in the future who will attend these colleges and universities.

Over the last decade, we've stopped:
* **Free speech zones** -- that limit students' free speech to small zones on campus.
* **Permission policies** -- where students have to beg campus administration for the right to speak on campus.
* **Pre-approval policies** -- where students have to submit materials to be approved by campus admin.

The Student Rights Campaign is how we fight against tyrannical policies on campuses that limit students' natural rights and show clear abuse of administrative power.

[_**Support the Student Rights Campaign today >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zip1trmc4aq0sifr3th293sqvev1g4a5d89mvqb0_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3g66o36cph2bs)

Here's how Young Americans for Liberty Foundation WINS on campus:

1. YAL students host an activism event on campus, or sometimes it's as simple as our students simply wanting to exercise their First Amendment rights.
2. **_Campus administrators approach students and tell them they violate the school 's speech policy while shutting them down._**
3. YAL students record the interaction, asking the bureaucrats what rule they are violating, why that rule exists, and what happens if they do not comply.
4. YAL partners with organizations like Foundation for Individual Rights in Education (FIRE) and Alliance Defending Freedom (ADF) to bring a lawsuit against the institution.
5. **The school is cornered and either agrees to change the policy or is forced to through litigation.**

And we fight for more than just free speech -- our policy fights range from privacy violations in times of Covid tyranny to restoring the right to non-lethal self-defense on campus.

[_**Help us prepare for the next ten campuses we 're targeting in January with a gift of $10, $25, $50, or any amount >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8sbimhpt9q856emarf00pvk21ojim0itbi9gi48_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3g66o36cph2bs)

There's a cultural shift happening. The new generation wants liberty and free speech.

**That 's why YAL is the nation's largest, most active, and most effective pro-liberty youth organization advancing liberty on campuses and in American politics. **

Please join this cultural shift and help me meet my goal of connecting with 100 new supporters. **Click below to send your gift today.**

name: Kari Lake
subject: My message to the People of Arizona & the United States:
body:
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zcq88sdne22ebpu351bqr7t4vo3g7remlv0f2rto_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3i68ob6cdh2bs)
---

To the People of Arizona and of the United States:

Printer problems, tabulation errors, 3-hour lines or longer, and confusing instructions given by election officials made this Election Day the most chaotic in Arizona's history.

Half of the Voting Centers that opened for the first time on Election Day (where the overwhelming majority of voters were voting for Kari Lake) were not operational or had significant failures.

Would you get on a plane if HALF of the engines didn't work? Would our friends in the media be able to broadcast their nightly propaganda if HALF of their studio equipment was not working? The 2022 General Election in Arizona was botched and broken beyond repair.

This isn't about Republicans or Democrats. This is about our sacred right to Vote, a right that many voters were, sadly, deprived of on November 8th. Tens of thousands have reached out, pleading with me to fight for them. Rest assured, I will. If we give up now, we will no longer have a Country.

Attorneys are working diligently to gather information, whistleblowers ARE coming forward, and the curtain is being lifted. Whether done accidentally or intentionally, it is clear that this Election was a debacle that destroyed any trust in our elections. Arizonans who chose to make their voice heard on Election Day shouldn't be disenfranchised or punished for choosing to vote in person. Yet they were.

I want you to know, Arizona, I will continue fighting until we restore confidence and faith in our elections.

body:

|
---
| | |
---
| Fellow Patriot,

This is Dr. Ben Carson, and I'm writing to you today because your name is on my list of Americans who [cherish our nation's guiding values of life, liberty, community, and faith.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq8j86jbour3amg688p1gn3vh3atlgcdmdoihsg8_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3i68ob1c9h2bs)

Have you ever stopped to think about how charitable giving is a brilliant reflection of freedom?

| Almost everything Governor Youngkin and other fellow Republican legislators tried to achieve legislatively in 2022 to lower taxes, improve elections, reduce regulations, and more was watered down or killed by the Democrat controlled State Senate. I'm running for State Senate so we can gain the majority and make Virginia the best place to live, work, and raise a family in peace. It starts with election integrity.
I invite you and your friends to join me in this cause. Please sign up now to be a delegate for the convention, TBD, and please share with friends via email here: [john@mcguireforvirginia.com](mailto:john@mcguireforvirginia.com)
Take care, please spread the word, and I look forward to seeing you around the district!

---
| |
Dear Fellow American, World War II is the greatest armed conflict in human history, encompassing global fighting in unprecedented ways. But today, only around one percent of the 16 million brave Americans who fought in the war are still alive. As we lose more and more of these courageous soldiers, we also lose the living memories they carry. But we must preserve the lessons learned from this world war.
---
| | That’s why Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled [“](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c41292%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=n2aJ66JfFsNXrCQ8TUoCpw&sysid=1)**[The Second World Wars.”](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c41293%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AiACbI%2feyOJ1QdResHBXew&sysid=1) **And right now, you can receive your very own DVD box set of this course when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. This limited-edition DVD set provides an analysis from military historian **Victor Davis Hanson** of Allied and Axis investments and strategies in the air, by water, and on land that led to the Allies’ victory. This is one of the most popular Hillsdale courses of all time. And there are only a limited number of DVDs available. If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can have one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.

Dear Peter:

**I have three simple rules for the Republican majority that takes power in January.**

**You can't trust the alligators to drain the swamp.**

And Republicans cannot ignore the message of the election, which is that the American people demand an end to swamp corruption.

But I need your help to make these rule changes happen.

I'm facing a critical end-of-month deadline at midnight.

Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don't know his full story-especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David's momentous story provides profound insights into many of life's most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **"The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King"** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David's character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---

subject: Have you seen what they’re doing to our kids?
body:
| | | Dear Fellow Conservative,
We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help to win...
[**That’s why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation of $35 or more today.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5ba80309495749188b145a78c1bf96b9&_e=dG-kxl35psWvmv7FZUKi1Dlwxj2nHHJgAx_sgSeXU2WvNhyWFkTyX1lpfV5Szw4KiEb7NaEjEyoEWS_g0x0ogLic32yD0vacKagRLxkqpVHZrldmhGjzpOj2U4C6-KX846bSAoDvORbZzD_PfF4HYnmZGIGq2gLr_sCPiNE569TdRdSMrZedi8Ims7H3LHdFABLzdCfg3M3UWWto4d5ckepxeHZgUoupyC8bD62LGpE8PUajN2-gYbEEhAsYzENmrrgb0Vf258cIVD9RBMnuLnIJDnVDNfEhrjw-7iMF77INRKSiDF7ZjcnZPFNsXhtBjbfmYXVKX71iKNI9TEU1oi1MKJmcVCHv4apulJbv7hoL8QRNQw-JtJPef5_ZYPnQ)
We recently filed suit against a school AND the activists pretending to be teachers to make them pay for what they’re doing to our young and vulnerable children.
Because the ONLY way we’re going to stop them -- is to make these extremists pay for their crimes... And that’s exactly what our landmark lawsuit does!
Let me quickly give you the details in case you missed us while we were on **Laura Ingraham** ’s great **Fox News **show talking about our case:
Jessica Konen, the mother of an innocent 12-year-old girl, was called into her daughter’s school and told that her daughter was now a “boy”.
She found out that her young daughter had been groomed into believing she was “transgender” and “bisexual”... Her impressionable daughter didn’t even know these words until they were forced on her by these radicals.
The school then pushed Jessica’s innocent daughter to create a whole new identity -- complete with a new boy’s name, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom...
They also created a “Gender Support Plan” and ordered the faculty to use her new name and pronouns -- all without her mother’s knowledge!
**And Jessica had no idea because her young daughter was told NOT to tell her mother since she couldn’t be “trusted”****.**
* These people are not real teachers.
* They’re not concerned with teaching our children to read...
* They’re not concerned with teaching our children math and arithmetic...
* They’re not concerned with teaching history...

They want to indoctrinate an entire generation of children to reject their parent’s values and embrace their radical Left-Wing propaganda -- and we have to stop them.
[**That’s why I’m asking you to rush in your donation of $35 or more to help us stop these child groomers now.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5ba80309495749188b145a78c1bf96b9&_e=dG-kxl35psWvmv7FZUKi1Dlwxj2nHHJgAx_sgSeXU2WvNhyWFkTyX1lpfV5Szw4KiEb7NaEjEyoEWS_g0x0ogLic32yD0vacKagRLxkqpVHZrldmhGjzpOj2U4C6-KX846bSAoDvORbZzD_PfF4HYnmZGIGq2gLr_sCPiNE569TdRdSMrZedi8Ims7H3LHdFABLzdCfg3M3UWWto4d5ckepxeHZgUoupyC8bD62LGpFkyeY2SfExKgVrq5jfzVeWf4AkhHO-Px2DQf1DJNfOxG3fBxDQ7AgNqq6LARPbPD_fwIfNbf0LX4DU6ONlK9vgE6s4U0vt1GaqkqgykShGxO6hR5I7EKunUeMcN7YhRvo3nePrJMgAG0afcJwgbMDt)
After all this, Jessica did what any good mother would do and questioned the principal about what was happening to her young daughter at school...
... And what happened next?
Child Protective Services was called to her house and “interviewed” her children!
This grooming is happening behind closed doors in classrooms across the country... And it’s happening in secret so parents, grandparents andthe community don’t know what’s going on.
Jessica’s innocent daughter is just one of the countless victims -- and if we don’t act, there will be more and more every day...
Since we announced our lawsuit **The Ingraham Angle** , tons of concerned parents, grandparents and teachers have reached out to us. It’s horrible and sickening that this is happening, but we have to stop it...
And our lawsuit is the key. Political pressure and new laws will not work -- we must drag these radical activists and schools into court and make them pay.
That’s why our lawsuit names the individual “teachers” -- we must hold **them** accountable...
Only when these extremists are scared of being dragged into court and are forced to pay will they stop.
Make no mistake -- if we win this landmark case every single one of these so-called teachers will take notice.
They will think of the consequences before pushing their radical agenda on our vulnerable children... [**So please, join me today with a donation of $35 or more to fund our lawsuit to protect our kids from out of control leftist teachers.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5ba80309495749188b145a78c1bf96b9&_e=dG-kxl35psWvmv7FZUKi1Dlwxj2nHHJgAx_sgSeXU2WvNhyWFkTyX1lpfV5Szw4KiEb7NaEjEyoEWS_g0x0ogLic32yD0vacKagRLxkqpVHZrldmhGjzpOj2U4C6-KX846bSAoDvORbZzD_PfF4HYnmZGIGq2gLr_sCPiNE569TdRdSMrZedi8Ims7H3LHdFABLzdCfg3M3UWWto4d5ckepxeHZgUoupyC8bD62LGpGxWGNrekY2htaxqRkDSDjJ9-kY8DZErupz9qBkWP-cAarZiA2g1IuJTKzgt5UpMiw93RpNslkOdRt6MQWpYuSheHOdfRRYQt6RGrS5XXn9RGr8LqeIDBD8VE_7wMbjEC72XhB4enO7hTavSbF5dOLl) But to stop them, we need to win this case...
And if you can give more today – $50, $100, $250 or more – I will use it to protect our children and our constitutional rights from these radical Left extremists.
But, whatever amount you can send, I ask that you rush it in right away. And please know that here at the Center for American Liberty we don’t just file lawsuits – we **WIN** them!!
We recently won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court and we’re fighting Big Tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives...
But this case to stop these extremists from corrupting and damaging our innocent children is too important to lose.
And the only way to stop them is to make them know we’re going to make them pay for their actions...
[**So please, join the fight today****with your emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100 or more today.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5ba80309495749188b145a78c1bf96b9&_e=dG-kxl35psWvmv7FZUKi1Dlwxj2nHHJgAx_sgSeXU2WvNhyWFkTyX1lpfV5Szw4KiEb7NaEjEyoEWS_g0x0ogLic32yD0vacKagRLxkqpVHZrldmhGjzpOj2U4C6-KX846bSAoDvORbZzD_PfF4HYnmZGIGq2gLr_sCPiNE569TdRdSMrZedi8Ims7H3LHdFABLzdCfg3M3UWWto4d5ckepxeHZgUoupyC8bD62LGpGuVVvVtDOnYAFVvMm8AntMOsU63UVHN2YB8067U-VCJMy_aQsJ8cXEFtnn9a_bpgtljtv9glFJUKaTH81hxZGgwieSmDBqd37PiXZf1154li1LCCOvCi3lnqWdpkzkAtj5Avbd5KyBpN8zH9i86KlZ)
We’re ready to go to the mat to win this case, but we can’t do it without you.
Thank you in advance for your support.
Sincerely,

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Will you help me restore America’s guiding values?
body:
|
---
| | |
---
| Fellow Patriot,

This is Dr. Ben Carson, and I'm writing to you today because your name is on my list of Americans who [cherish our nation's guiding values of life, liberty, community, and faith.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=82f252e643c741b49dff7ac4d63f5867&_e=TXukYVUzcYe5wFqiD9k8BA8fJiI_OwGjc3-mMJwVpXP0jIsanpdytcq4CKoHIttfIn51VkeOOIru6L0JkbV7MNYG5ge2OExwntZM4-ohbZDi1tw8eQLOoHW-W04lDkssFsqHSeSWSTnaQvDQ_BaqtWKPGym-Immhhe5-JBTzF69Zk_lR7mKxRb0n3PGnyGzXeg9erY4aAQwLl3r6bkmJHU_cTwVvgB8a17TIqQ0pUn4M0dwQjg10NOqCcuuBxcFUlQ-QMkM0nm9TKwLAmefvoNhmvvIay-FbQOSG0-L52GqDwt9EAG95xCwFfgOjOclS391cPJn-HdRae6sRo0W0Bbzee6cHOXZl1p60oYUbDzQ%3D)

Have you ever stopped to think about how charitable giving is a brilliant reflection of freedom?

It's a way for every American to use our hard-earned money to freely support the causes we care most about.

This is democracy in action: [because every dollar you give is a vote for the future you want to see.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=82f252e643c741b49dff7ac4d63f5867&_e=TXukYVUzcYe5wFqiD9k8BA8fJiI_OwGjc3-mMJwVpXP0jIsanpdytcq4CKoHIttfIn51VkeOOIru6L0JkbV7MNYG5ge2OExwntZM4-ohbZDi1tw8eQLOoHW-W04lDkssFsqHSeSWSTnaQvDQ_BaqtWKPGym-Immhhe5-JBTzF69Zk_lR7mKxRb0n3PGnyGzXeg9erY4aAQwLl3r6bkmJHbhRfvYJJRWS6YnLiFq9DxNMPFI6uejU7NUrCbKuCjNTkpGfqjj-KJ6QCU0B3FolWuoHcroK9N6UkS5AlXJJvdrclFXK0fwRgoZWiCaGodBG9BteyEf_WimCKK5BNCicW7b1uC8N8SOWJRlwNPLzv_A%3D)

And during this special season of giving, I'd like to personally invite you to join me in advancing common-sense solutions to our nation's toughest challenges by [making a generous year-end gift of whatever your budget allows.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=82f252e643c741b49dff7ac4d63f5867&_e=TXukYVUzcYe5wFqiD9k8BA8fJiI_OwGjc3-mMJwVpXP0jIsanpdytcq4CKoHIttfIn51VkeOOIru6L0JkbV7MNYG5ge2OExwntZM4-ohbZDi1tw8eQLOoHW-W04lDkssFsqHSeSWSTnaQvDQ_BaqtWKPGym-Immhhe5-JBTzF69Zk_lR7mKxRb0n3PGnyGzXeg9erY4aAQwLl3r6bkmJHY7vP3KbkcKtmjygPAaHUbyQ8TEwJ8lrYhm-BCNYqeZGEKmJcRFXZOTVmbr7Fd72XmpON3xwMF2q5iwl08EzZDUG4OBLkC5lzBq-6-lGEnEoeCN5CiQlvVz91GqOXPfc-7St5yHZTtcOrzn0qAknAxs%3D)

Your investment will allow the American Cornerstone Institute to engage in independent research, grassroots outreach, and collaboration with conservative leaders to set forth a better path forward for our country, [safeguarding freedom for you and your family in 2023 and beyond.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=82f252e643c741b49dff7ac4d63f5867&_e=TXukYVUzcYe5wFqiD9k8BA8fJiI_OwGjc3-mMJwVpXP0jIsanpdytcq4CKoHIttfIn51VkeOOIru6L0JkbV7MNYG5ge2OExwntZM4-ohbZDi1tw8eQLOoHW-W04lDkssFsqHSeSWSTnaQvDQ_BaqtWKPGym-Immhhe5-JBTzF69Zk_lR7mKxRb0n3PGnyGzXeg9erY4aAQwLl3r6bkmJHRcgEQ661xvPAbve_GxHbLWwQtcFnYKE0-L35Mcg1xafuIOSZSgRdX50RV7U_z-wP9vMmYWsLLtaiBvGpKbgLVQMy9qoUIR_zsvNMEtCOEBXdzqdSA32dDYDyFHxFbORZ2jcBwULC8OzJWn1nIBT9r8%3D)

Will you join me? If so, you can support these effort by clicking the link below:

**[**https://secure.americancornerstone.org/giving-season**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=82f252e643c741b49dff7ac4d63f5867&_e=TXukYVUzcYe5wFqiD9k8BA8fJiI_OwGjc3-mMJwVpXP0jIsanpdytcq4CKoHIttfIn51VkeOOIru6L0JkbV7MNYG5ge2OExwntZM4-ohbZDi1tw8eQLOoHW-W04lDkssFsqHSeSWSTnaQvDQ_BaqtWKPGym-Immhhe5-JBTzF69Zk_lR7mKxRb0n3PGnyGzXeg9erY4aAQwLl3r6bkmJHRVKkOJRmlLD8t9-Y7so3Vj6R5XA8ZLL7GSLg3kofqwPiqNaFFGFvwtqTrBrr1AGtZHHJ54JMTjl4YJhGXwMDxtcJWvIIb7LMCIsnO0LBQcsLY0SdRrv09FzOKg1ftxnZOS_fU5nU4l9rsRSVizKvZw%3D)**

Where the Left wants bigger government, we'll fight for limited government and self-determination.

America is the greatest country that has ever existed. Please help me do everything possible to make sure it stays that way.

Thank you for your support,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

P.S. I know these are uncertain times. But no gift is too small. And every dollar you give today will have a long-term impact on restoring our nation's founding values. [**Click here to give whatever you can today »**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=82f252e643c741b49dff7ac4d63f5867&_e=TXukYVUzcYe5wFqiD9k8BA8fJiI_OwGjc3-mMJwVpXP0jIsanpdytcq4CKoHIttfIn51VkeOOIru6L0JkbV7MNYG5ge2OExwntZM4-ohbZDi1tw8eQLOoHW-W04lDkssFsqHSeSWSTnaQvDQ_BaqtWKPGym-Immhhe5-JBTzF69Zk_lR7mKxRb0n3PGnyGzXeg9erY4aAQwLl3r6bkmJHU0hZmxi7YKDTOwFTcvAEOUyv6jhE6zFlBi1mPnzO7kwzFDZv4L73dNCHxbHXcPs6HZK78UXDv6xTazXRUBUUex4zL7w5Xk2sKS7z1cnYS5rXpOZIV3aSvlUMChmNyd5i8-Ws0Gu9rw9DMLh5ujBOLU%3D)

name: Tom Homan
subject: We’re suing the Biden administration…
body:
Without borders and without the rule of law we have nothing.

| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61996451:Jy9EhlGzN:m:1:3331421248:D2197C766009FD1C3710FF0A8EDB557F:r)

Peter,

Violent crime is climbing to rates we haven't seen since the 80s and 90s, but that's not enough for Joe Biden.

It's not enough that police are in retreat in almost every major American city...

And it's not enough that left-wing district attorneys let lifelong violent criminals roam the streets...

Now the Biden Administration is putting Americans in even MORE danger.

How? This administration is literally prohibiting immigration officers from removing illegal aliens!

**That's why the Immigration Reform Law Institute (IRLI) is representing a group of counties, sheriffs, and immigration enforcement officers in their lawsuit against the Biden Administration,**[**and why I hope I can count on your support today.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61996451:Jy9EhlGzN:m:1:3331421248:D2197C766009FD1C3710FF0A8EDB557F:r)

You see, right now aliens convicted of sexual battery on a child, domestic violence, and drunk driving have been released under the policy onto the streets and highways of America.

I don't want to live in a country where criminals run the show. But that is essentially what will happen if these dangerous polices are allowed to continue.

**Joe Biden's anti-borders immigration policies are going to transform the United States of America into a country few of us would recognize or want to live in, and one of the most powerful tools we have to stop him is that of the law.**

[**We're trying to stop them, but we can't do it without your generous support. Will you join the fight with a gift of $35 or more today?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61996451:Jy9EhlGzN:m:1:3331421248:D2197C766009FD1C3710FF0A8EDB557F:r)

My name is Tom Homan, and I'm the former acting director of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and a Senior Fellow at IRLI.

As acting director of ICE, I saw exactly what we're up against.

I got to know all about the criminals pouring into our country.

And I can tell you that there's nothing more concerning to me than a president that won't let immigration enforcement professionals do their jobs.

That's why I'm so proud of the work that IRLI does.

Every time our legal team has taken on the Biden Administration, we've won.

And that's thanks to patriots like you.

[**If you're in the position to make a generous gift of $35 or more today and help make IRLI 6-0 against the Biden administration, I hope you will.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61996451:Jy9EhlGzN:m:1:3331421248:D2197C766009FD1C3710FF0A8EDB557F:r)

Because nothing we do is possible without people like you in our corner.

We have a small group of dedicated attorneys working around the clock, sacrificing the riches and fame they'd make at other law firms, because they know that without borders, we have no America.

**And they know that America is worth fighting for.**

When they take on a case and spend hours upon hours devising legal strategy, they don't charge a dime.

They don't take the big, D.C. salaries (that they're more than qualified for) because they want to make every dollar donated stretch as far as it can for their clients, cases, and country.

But we still need dollars to stretch.

These legal battles are no small undertaking, and to put things plainly, we can't win them without the funds. **That's why we are trying to raise $100,000 more dollars in the next TEN DAYS to shore up our resources as we pursue this legal battle.**

Will you help us meet this goal?

We recently filed in court a request for a preliminary injunction against the Biden Administration for protecting illegal aliens from deportation, and we won't win it without you.

[**Please make a generous donation of $35 or more today and give our attorneys the ammunition they need.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61996451:Jy9EhlGzN:m:1:3331421248:D2197C766009FD1C3710FF0A8EDB557F:r)

This lawsuit is absolutely critical to defending our borders and making sure the Biden Administration can't turn our nation into a lawless free-for-all.

Your support means the world to us, and to your country.

Sincerely,

Tom Homan
Former Acting Director of the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement,
Senior Fellow at Immigration Reform Law Institute

[ >> DONATE << ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61996451:Jy9EhlGzN:m:1:3331421248:D2197C766009FD1C3710FF0A8EDB557F:r)

name: Tom Homan
subject: We’re suing the Biden administration…
body:
Without borders and without the rule of law we have nothing.
Without borders and without the rule of law we have nothing.

| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zrfcurasrg8100led6jne37oirlofo9r06ip9qo8_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3h6eor6cth2bs)

Fellow concerned American,

Violent crime is climbing to rates we haven’t seen since the 80s and 90s – but that’s not enough for Joe Biden.

It’s not enough that police are in retreat in almost every major American city...

And it’s not enough that left-wing district attorneys let lifelong violent criminals roam the streets...

Now the Biden Administration is putting Americans in even MORE danger.

How? This administration is literally prohibiting immigration officers from removing illegal aliens!

**That’s why the Immigration Reform Law Institute (IRLI) is representing a group of counties, sheriffs, and immigration enforcement officers in their lawsuit against the Biden Administration –**[**and why I hope I can count on your support today.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z3avsovlep078gfn9b9hkknr4kccecvrn36d47n8_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3h6eor6cth2bs)

You see, right now aliens convicted of sexual battery on a child, domestic violence, and drunk driving have been released under the policy onto the streets and highways of America.

I don’t want to live in a country where criminals run the show. But that is essentially what will happen if these dangerous polices are allowed to continue.

**Joe Biden’s anti-borders immigration policies are going to transform the United States of America into a country few of us would recognize or want to live in – and one of the most powerful tools we have to stop him is that of the law.**

[**We’re trying to stop them – but we can’t do it without your generous support. Will you join the fight with a gift of $35 or more today?**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z3s6evm40v8dk1qdh6ebrlnmvrq620aqkfff33g8_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3h6eor6cth2bs)

My name is Tom Homan, and I’m the former acting director of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and a Senior Fellow at IRLI.

As acting director of ICE, I saw exactly what we’re up against.

I got to know all about the criminals pouring into our country.

And I can tell you that there’s nothing more concerning to me than a president that won’t let immigration enforcement professionals do their jobs.

That’s why I’m so proud of the work that IRLI does.

Every time our legal team has taken on the Biden Administration, we’ve won.

And that’s thanks to patriots like you.

[**If you’re in the position to make a generous gift of $35 or more today and help make IRLI 6-0 against the Biden administration, I hope you will.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zb43jolic0gulq8ct7dcpfjt7trb15334sa1u46o_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3h6eor6cth2bs)

Because nothing we do is possible without people like you in our corner.

We have a small group of dedicated attorneys working around the clock, sacrificing the riches and fame they’d make at other law firms, because they know that without borders, we have no America.

**And they know that America is worth fighting for.**

When they take on a case and spend hours upon hours devising legal strategy, they don’t charge a dime.

They don’t take the big, D.C. salaries (that they’re more than qualified for) because they want to make every dollar donated stretch as far as it can for their clients, cases, and country.

But we still need dollars to stretch.

These legal battles are no small undertaking, and to put things plainly, we can’t win them without the funds. **That’s why we are trying to raise $100,000 more dollars in the next TEN DAYS to shore up our resources as we pursue this legal battle.**

Will you help us meet this goal?

We recently filed in court a request for a preliminary injunction against the Biden Administration for protecting illegal aliens from deportation, and we won’t win it without you.

[**Please make a generous donation of $35 or more today and give our attorneys the ammunition they need.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zbnsoch9su6p9is58ahhk3iqetscq8t5m7pqj5o8_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3h6eor6cth2bs)

This lawsuit is absolutely critical to defending our borders and making sure the Biden Administration can’t turn our nation into a lawless free-for-all.

Your support means the world to us, and to your country.

Sincerely,

Tom Homan
Former Acting Director of the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement,
Senior Fellow at Immigration Reform Law Institutetute

[ >> DONATE << ](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z36suao327l3hb9e0tumhjmr6ad3228dveitab00_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3h6eor6cth2bs)
