name: Tom Homan
subject: Peter , we’re suing the Biden administration…
body:
Without borders and without the rule of law we have nothing.

| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61996486:6iINDlGyN:m:1:3331703221:E26B9A9FD583AA51332F9E760C13CED0:r)

Peter,

Violent crime is climbing to rates we haven't seen since the 80s and 90s, but that's not enough for Joe Biden.

It's not enough that police are in retreat in almost every major American city...

And it's not enough that left-wing district attorneys let lifelong violent criminals roam the streets...

Now the Biden Administration is putting Americans in even MORE danger.

How? This administration is literally prohibiting immigration officers from removing illegal aliens!

**That's why the Immigration Reform Law Institute (IRLI) is representing a group of counties, sheriffs, and immigration enforcement officers in their lawsuit against the Biden Administration,**[**and why I hope I can count on your support today.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61996486:6iINDlGyN:m:1:3331703221:E26B9A9FD583AA51332F9E760C13CED0:r)

You see, right now aliens convicted of sexual battery on a child, domestic violence, and drunk driving have been released under the policy onto the streets and highways of America.

I don't want to live in a country where criminals run the show. But that is essentially what will happen if these dangerous polices are allowed to continue.

**Joe Biden's anti-borders immigration policies are going to transform the United States of America into a country few of us would recognize or want to live in, and one of the most powerful tools we have to stop him is that of the law.**

[**We're trying to stop them, but we can't do it without your generous support. Will you join the fight with a gift today?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61996486:6iINDlGyN:m:1:3331703221:E26B9A9FD583AA51332F9E760C13CED0:r)

My name is Tom Homan, and I'm the former acting director of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and a Senior Fellow at IRLI.

As acting director of ICE, I saw exactly what we're up against.

I got to know all about the criminals pouring into our country.

And I can tell you that there's nothing more concerning to me than a president that won't let immigration enforcement professionals do their jobs.

That's why I'm so proud of the work that IRLI does.

Every time our legal team has taken on the Biden Administration, we've won.

And that's thanks to patriots like you.

[**If you're in the position to make a generous gift of $35 or more today and help make IRLI 6-0 against the Biden administration, I hope you will.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61996486:6iINDlGyN:m:1:3331703221:E26B9A9FD583AA51332F9E760C13CED0:r)

Because nothing we do is possible without people like you in our corner.

We have a small group of dedicated attorneys working around the clock, sacrificing the riches and fame they'd make at other law firms, because they know that without borders, we have no America.

**And they know that America is worth fighting for.**

When they take on a case and spend hours upon hours devising legal strategy, they don't charge a dime.

They don't take the big, D.C. salaries (that they're more than qualified for) because they want to make every dollar donated stretch as far as it can for their clients, cases, and country.

But we still need dollars to stretch.

These legal battles are no small undertaking, and to put things plainly, we can't win them without the funds. **That's why we are trying to raise $100,000 more dollars in the next TEN DAYS to shore up our resources as we pursue this legal battle.**

Will you help us meet this goal?

We recently filed in court a request for a preliminary injunction against the Biden Administration for protecting illegal aliens from deportation, and we won't win it without you.

[**Please make a generous donation today and give our attorneys the ammunition they need.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61996486:6iINDlGyN:m:1:3331703221:E26B9A9FD583AA51332F9E760C13CED0:r)

This lawsuit is absolutely critical to defending our borders and making sure the Biden Administration can't turn our nation into a lawless free-for-all.

Your support means the world to us, and to your country.

Sincerely,

Tom Homan
Former Acting Director of the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement,
Senior Fellow at Immigration Reform Law Institute

| **ROGER STONE: The Hispanic Shift To The GOP - And Why Democrats Should Be Terrified** While the red wave many expected in the midterm elections was more like a pink drizzle, the inroads Republicans made with Hispanic voters cannot be understated and reveal a historic trend that will upend American politics. [](https://102671.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=68d1l8amweyloi09ze&linkid=1&link=d87bf02cf4654b28bc971357ef57478f) **While the red wave many expected in the midterm elections was more like a pink drizzle, the inroads Republicans made with Hispanic voters cannot be understated and reveal a historic trend that will upend American politics. The GOP was able to cut the Democrats ' margin with Hispanic voters in half, to just D+21 - the best midterm performance for Republicans EVER.** A memo from Giancarlo Sopo, the founder of Visto Media and one of the most respected analysts in the Republican Party, showcases just how important this increase is for Republicans, focusing on key battleground states like Arizona, Florida, and Georgia, where the shift among Hispanics from Democrat to Republican is most pronounced all three states are crucial to any possibility of Republicans garnering 270 Electoral Votes in the next presidential election. In Florida, Hispanics were instrumental in the landslide victories of both Gov. Ron DeSantis and Sen. Marco Rubio. They secured 58% and 56% of the Hispanic vote respectively. Among Cubans, a historically strong Republican voting block, DeSantis and Rubio performed even better, winning a staggering 69% and 67% of the vote, but Republicans also posted substantial gains among Venezuelan and Colombian Americans. But perhaps the biggest surprise was their growing support among Puerto Ricans, a traditionally heavily Democrat constituency with DeSantis increasing his support by over 20 points compared to when he was first elected in 2018! "You can't have a static presentation of a message in an early voting process. You have to conform your message and your implementation to that. We didn't. We have got to learn how to play the early voting game." Manafort gave a candid assessment of why Democrats will keep the Senate and the GOP will only have a slim House majority in 2023 after the red wave many conservatives expected failed to translate into the expected range of election wins. name: Tom Brejcha
subject: Stand with David Daleiden
body:
Dear Peter, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he's been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992136:JYTsWlGwN:m:1:3350876382:1BD25152FD076BC1CBE8B21BA18000B2:r)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now Vice-President Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992136:JYTsWlGwN:m:1:3350876382:1BD25152FD076BC1CBE8B21BA18000B2:r)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992136:JYTsWlGwN:m:1:3350876382:1BD25152FD076BC1CBE8B21BA18000B2:r)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood's nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We're fighting back, but we'll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment, they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992136:JYTsWlGwN:m:1:3350876382:1BD25152FD076BC1CBE8B21BA18000B2:r)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate to stand with David Daleiden today.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992136:JYTsWlGwN:m:1:3350876382:1BD25152FD076BC1CBE8B21BA18000B2:r)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel P.S. Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. Can I count on you to support the official criminal defense of David Daleiden? **[David is a pro-life hero. Will you make a generous donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to stop this attempt to crush him?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992136:JYTsWlGwN:m:1:3350876382:1BD25152FD076BC1CBE8B21BA18000B2:r)** [**DONATE**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992136:JYTsWlGwN:m:1:3350876382:1BD25152FD076BC1CBE8B21BA18000B2:r) [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992136:JYTsWlGwN:m:1:3350876382:1BD25152FD076BC1CBE8B21BA18000B2:r) The Thomas More Society is a not-for-profit, national public interest law firm dedicated to restoring respect in law for life, family, and religious liberty. [Please consider supporting our efforts with a generous, tax-deductible donation.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992136:JYTsWlGwN:m:1:3350876382:1BD25152FD076BC1CBE8B21BA18000B2:r) (C) Thomas More Society | [www.thomasmoresociety.org](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992137:JYTsWlGwN:m:1:3350876382:1BD25152FD076BC1CBE8B21BA18000B2:r)
309 W. Washington Street Suite 1250, Chicago, IL 60606

subject: This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle
body:
Dear Peter, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he's been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992122:6UcuWlGCN:m:1:3345639852:AE25D6AD3A37DD2E2CEA9A109B4331C4:r)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now Vice-President Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992122:6UcuWlGCN:m:1:3345639852:AE25D6AD3A37DD2E2CEA9A109B4331C4:r)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992122:6UcuWlGCN:m:1:3345639852:AE25D6AD3A37DD2E2CEA9A109B4331C4:r)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood's nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We're fighting back, but we'll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment, they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate $35 or more to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992122:6UcuWlGCN:m:1:3345639852:AE25D6AD3A37DD2E2CEA9A109B4331C4:r)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate to stand with David Daleiden today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992122:6UcuWlGCN:m:1:3345639852:AE25D6AD3A37DD2E2CEA9A109B4331C4:r)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel P.S. Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. Peter,

By now you know Herschel Walker is in the fight of his life. He's gearing up to face off against the socialist Democrat, Raphael Warnock, in a December 6th Senate runoff that will determine the extent to which Democrats have control over the Senate.

I think a lot of folks, yourself included perhaps, may be thinking that this race isn't important given that Democrats have 50 votes plus Kamala Harris' tie-breaking vote - effectively giving them control of the Senate. body:
Dear Peter, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services \-- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he's been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992159:J8kOclGN-:m:1:3359512271:7000CBC6050C326E2F0E696EDEFC0562:r)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now Vice-President Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992159:J8kOclGN-:m:1:3359512271:7000CBC6050C326E2F0E696EDEFC0562:r)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992159:J8kOclGN-:m:1:3359512271:7000CBC6050C326E2F0E696EDEFC0562:r)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood's nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We're fighting back, but we'll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment, they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992159:J8kOclGN-:m:1:3359512271:7000CBC6050C326E2F0E696EDEFC0562:r)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. ... name: Tom Homan
subject: We’re suing the Biden administration…
body:
Without borders and without the rule of law we have nothing.
Without borders and without the rule of law we have nothing.

| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlae54r0jcu2su5tjhqh1guiguutdg0uc40pspo0_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3h69ob2clh2bs)

Fellow concerned American,

Violent crime is climbing to rates we haven’t seen since the 80s and 90s – but that’s not enough for Joe Biden.

It’s not enough that police are in retreat in almost every major American city...

And it’s not enough that left-wing district attorneys let lifelong violent criminals roam the streets...

Now the Biden Administration is putting Americans in even MORE danger.

How? This administration is literally prohibiting immigration officers from removing illegal aliens!

**That’s why the Immigration Reform Law Institute (IRLI) is representing a group of counties, sheriffs, and immigration enforcement officers in their lawsuit against the Biden Administration –**[**and why I hope I can count on your support today.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zufs1v4fv18secnk7evfbj1e1cvu22m4hrrmdu58_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3h69ob2clh2bs)

You see, right now aliens convicted of sexual battery on a child, domestic violence, and drunk driving have been released under the policy onto the streets and highways of America.

I don’t want to live in a country where criminals run the show. But that is essentially what will happen if these dangerous polices are allowed to continue.

**Joe Biden’s anti-borders immigration policies are going to transform the United States of America into a country few of us would recognize or want to live in – and one of the most powerful tools we have to stop him is that of the law.**

[**We’re trying to stop them – but we can’t do it without your generous support. Will you join the fight with a gift of $35 or more today?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlb6jo8190rm3dhi8keq1pimpcffpjmcg8bkvrro_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3h69ob2clh2bs)

My name is Tom Homan, and I’m the former acting director of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and a Senior Fellow at IRLI.

As acting director of ICE, I saw exactly what we’re up against.

I got to know all about the criminals pouring into our country.

And I can tell you that there’s nothing more concerning to me than a president that won’t let immigration enforcement professionals do their jobs.

That’s why I’m so proud of the work that IRLI does.

Every time our legal team has taken on the Biden Administration, we’ve won.

And that’s thanks to patriots like you.

[**If you’re in the position to make a generous gift of $35 or more today and help make IRLI 6-0 against the Biden administration, I hope you will.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zspiu30miheo98vhdst2og0kdo9jps7uvovi82kg_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3h69ob2clh2bs)

Because nothing we do is possible without people like you in our corner.

We have a small group of dedicated attorneys working around the clock, sacrificing the riches and fame they’d make at other law firms, because they know that without borders, we have no America.

**And they know that America is worth fighting for.**

When they take on a case and spend hours upon hours devising legal strategy, they don’t charge a dime.

They don’t take the big, D.C. salaries (that they’re more than qualified for) because they want to make every dollar donated stretch as far as it can for their clients, cases, and country.

But we still need dollars to stretch.

These legal battles are no small undertaking, and to put things plainly, we can’t win them without the funds. **That’s why we are trying to raise $100,000 more dollars in the next TEN DAYS to shore up our resources as we pursue this legal battle.**

Will you help us meet this goal?

We recently filed in court a request for a preliminary injunction against the Biden Administration for protecting illegal aliens from deportation, and we won’t win it without you.

[**Please make a generous donation of $35 or more today and give our attorneys the ammunition they need.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zroidjkcppvrof31c35cieh3cntj9uqc0rkmrfeo_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3h69ob2clh2bs)

This lawsuit is absolutely critical to defending our borders and making sure the Biden Administration can’t turn our nation into a lawless free-for-all.

Your support means the world to us, and to your country.

Sincerely,

Tom Homan
Former Acting Director of the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement,
Senior Fellow at Immigration Reform Law Institutetute

Because the ONLY way we're going to stop them -- is to make these extremists pay for their crimes... And that's exactly what our landmark lawsuit does! name: Michael Bennet
subject: We passed the Respect for Marriage Act, but we have so much more work to do.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Bennet for Colorado
body:
Content Warning: This email talks about gun violence. | **Last night, I cast my vote to pass the _Respect For Marriage Act_ to recognize same-sex marriage at the federal level. **Enshrining the right to marry who you love is a major step forward for the LGBTQ community and for anyone who values equality in America. It should have been a moment of joy. But my joy, and the joy of so many in our state, was blunted by the loss we suffered last weekend in Colorado Springs, when a violent young man — radicalized by hateful and divisive rhetoric — killed five people at Club Q and forever changed a community. In minutes, he robbed from us brothers, sisters, daughters, sons, friends, and loved ones, who were just being themselves in a place they felt safe. He took from us five vibrant young Coloradans: Derrick Rump, Daniel Davis Aston, Kelly Loving, Ashley Paugh, and Raymond Green Vance. **I stood on the Senate floor and read those names and showed their photos to remind my colleagues and America that, even as we take a major step in the fight for equality, there is so much work left to be done.** We need to pass common-sense gun safety measures to keep guns out of the wrong hands, and we need to combat bigoted rhetoric and online extremism. We need to stand with the LGBTQ community everywhere, from the floor of the Senate to our own communities, and we can start by banning conversion therapy and passing the _Equality Act_ at the federal level, as we’ve done at the state level in Colorado. **We cannot bring back those we’ve lost, but together we must build a safer and more equitable America to keep all our communities safe in the future.** I will never stop fighting for that, and I am glad to have you with me. In solidarity, Michael |

But my joy, and the joy of so many in our state, was blunted by the loss we suffered last weekend in Colorado Springs, when a violent young man — radicalized by hateful and divisive rhetoric — killed five people at Club Q and forever changed a community. In minutes, he robbed from us brothers, sisters, daughters, sons, friends, and loved ones, who were just being themselves in a place they felt safe. He took from us five vibrant young Coloradans: Derrick Rump, Daniel Davis Aston, Kelly Loving, Ashley Paugh, and Raymond Green Vance. I stood on the Senate floor and read those names and showed their photos to remind my colleagues and America that, even as we take a major step in the fight for equality, there is so much work left to be done. We need to pass common-sense gun safety measures to keep guns out of the wrong hands, and we need to combat bigoted rhetoric and online extremism. We need to stand with the LGBTQ community everywhere, from the floor of the Senate to our own communities, and we can start by banning conversion therapy and passing the Equality Act at the federal level, as we’ve done at the state level in Colorado. We cannot bring back those we’ve lost, but together we must build a safer and more equitable America to keep all our communities safe in the future. I will never stop fighting for that, and I am glad to have you with me. In solidarity, Michael | Bennet for Colorado PO Box 3078 Denver, CO 80201 United States | mailto:info@michaelbennet.com | Paid for by Bennet for Colorado By clicking the links above, you certify that you are responsible for paying all charges incurred in using the debit or credit card to be charged, and that your personal funds will be the true source of the contribution.

Voters sent a clear message during this midterm election by supporting candidates and ballot initiatives that will strengthen our democracy.

As the election unfolded, we saw voters in places like Colorado, Pennsylvania, North Carolina, Minnesota and Michigan vote with fairer maps than we’ve seen in decades. **This is the progress we’ve been working toward.**

But it wasn’t all good news. Voters in four states -- Alabama, Georgia, Louisiana, and Ohio -- voted with unconstitutional maps where politicians chose their voters instead of the other way around. That’s why this fight isn’t over.

body:
I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal
And we're defending him in court!

| | | Fellow American, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. **With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming.** Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort – which is why our team is representing him in court. [**Can I count on your best gift of $40 or more to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND to help us give him the legal defense he deserves?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zf0gmjt3apvi3t4qab74nqckdqjlah75ias1d4p0_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3j6co34cph2bs) Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, **a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways**. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. So, Biden's Department of Justice charged Mark with violating the federal FACE Act...** _and now this courageous pro-life hero faces up to eleven years in federal prison for advocating for life and for defending his family._** We're pulling out all the stops to make sure the DOJ and the abortion clinic escort who are trying to destroy Mark and his family don't get away with this. But this is going to be a long, costly affair, and I need your help. [**That's where your emergency donation to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND comes in – by giving today you can stand with Mark in his hour of need.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zj0k9j4tnm726bfdpt2qt4laqt8kas8l9nl5p8v8_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3j6co34cph2bs) Make no mistake, friend, Mark's arrest was a targeted attack specifically intended to intimidate pro-lifers and people of faith. The incident at the abortion clinic was so minor that the authorities refused to press charges and when the escort filed charges himself, his case was thrown out. Fortunately for Mark and his family, if anyone has experience defending pro-life heroes against Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood, it's us. My name is Tom Brejcha and I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society – the not-for-profit law firm defending Mark Houck. We're proud to have defended many renowned leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe Scheidler and the Pro-Life Action League, David Bereit, David Daleiden, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, Lila Rose and Live Action, the March for Life, and many more. But without the help of generous donors, none of our crucial work would be possible. Because the reality is, while you can't be the one personally defending Mark in the courtroom, by donating you can help us vindicate this brave father and pro-life hero who is being ground through the system in an unjust prosecution. **[Can I count on your gift of $40, $60, $100, or more to stand with Mark Houck today and fight back against the dark forces of Planned Parenthood?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zg8gcsgbb5vp625u1ra6bde38f10o4d4arkjr9fo_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3j6co34cph2bs) ** I will be grateful for whatever you're able to send today. Whether it's $10, $40, $60, $250 or more... ...because time is of the essence. We're expecting Mark's defense to cost us hundreds of thousands of dollars. To put it as bluntly as possible, **_Mark could be facing years behind bars for a crime he didn't commit, while his seven children grow up without him and his wife Ryan-Marie is forced to raise their family alone._** Not only that, but pro-life sidewalk counselors across the country may be deterred from going to the clinics out of concern that they, too, could end up in costly legal battles and even face federal charges simply for defending the unborn. So, I do ask that you make your gift as soon as you can. [**Please don't delay in donating to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND immediately.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zp4jgk2dafkqo3792sq1ehl4khj3ssm9l4god71o_rp22sh2s8i66or4s3j6co34cph2bs)
I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get your generous gift so I can let Mark know that you're standing with him. I know Mark and his family will be deeply touched by your generous support. May God bless you,

Wade_ , Justice Clarence Thomas and MAGA-Republicans suggested that the Supreme Court should go after same-sex marriage rights next. subject: It’s not luck

body:
Our wins this year have come from years and years of hard work to cut through the partisan divide and make gun safety a winning issue.
#

Friend, it’s not luck that we saw successes in the fight to end gun violence this year.
It’s not luck that over 84% of our endorsed candidates won their elections this year.
It’s not luck that this year, President Biden was able to sign into law the most significant gun safety legislation that we’ve seen in nearly 30 years.
These wins have come from hard work—years and years of researching and campaigning to cut through the partisan divide and make gun safety a winning issue. And we couldn’t do this work without the support of people like you.
We’ve come so far but of course, we still have so much more work to do. Every day in America, people are still dying from senseless acts of gun violence. These are deaths we can prevent through common sense gun safety legislation to keep guns out of the hands of people who shouldn’t have them. We have solutions, but we need our elected officials to listen.
I know we’ve asked for your help a lot this year. But there’s no time to slow down. Not when people in our nation still can’t go shopping, go to school, or go to work without the threat of gunfire looming over them.
Tonight, we close the books on our November fundraising drive, and we need your help to reach our November fundraising goal. Our work depends on the generous support of grassroots donors like you.

clean_body: We're ready to get back to work | | | Hi Peter, We'll be honest — we took some time to take some much-needed rest after the midterm elections. After we loaded up on Thanksgiving foods, family time, and replaying our historic Democratic wins we achieved, we thought we would give you an update on what comes next. The midterm elections made it clear - when Democrats put resources behind organizing and communicating with rural voters, we can win big. But, the 2022 elections also showed that when the Democratic Party fails to support rural voters, we lose opportunities. When the margins are this tight and races mean the difference between a Democratic or Republican-controlled Congress, every race counts. That's why we'll be rolling out a new strategy for prioritizing rural voters in the coming year. We'll also continue our work consulting with campaigns, organizations, and politicians to make sure rural Americans are cut in on the deal and not overlooked in politics. We can't wait to share more information with you, but in the meantime, we want to ask if you will help us continue to be able to support rural voters and organize for Democrats. Thank you for your support, Peter. Talk to you soon (once we finish our Thanksgiving leftovers)! – United Rural Democrats HQ United Rural Democrats (URD) is leading the effort to rebuild the Democratic Party in rural America. If we're going to take back our country, we need a 50-state strategy to organize in every community across the country. Will you support our network of activists on the ground as we work to rebuild our party's infrastructure and flip these areas blue?

| | | An Anti-Defamation League investigation found that hundreds of members of the far-right extremist "Oath Keepers" militia are police officers, members of the armed forces, or elected officials. All told, 370 law enforcement officers, over 100 military servicemen, and 80 elected or aspiring public officials are members of the white supremacist militia. This extremist group is one of the key groups that played a role in organizing the January 6th insurrection. This news sounds alarm bells and raises serious concerns about extremists working in law enforcement and serving public office. With the future of our democracy at stake, we cannot allow these extremist views at any level of our government. The members on this leaked list should be immediately fired or removed from office. We’re preparing for a Republican-controlled House and **the stakes are high.** The GOP will almost certainly try to roll back all of our progress and continue to strip Americans of our civil and human rights.

Earlier this month, I was proud to represent Washington state at a historic U.N. Climate Change Conference. I left with hope, but also determination that we must do more to stop our world from careening down a deadly warming path.
So when the legislature convenes at the start of the year, Democrats have a mandate to lead with the urgency that this moment demands. We'll continue fighting to pass bold legislation to combat the climate crisis, and I'll be pushing for us to enshrine the right to choose into the state constitution.
But before the legislative session begins along with the state-mandated fundraising freeze, I'm coming to you with an urgent ask to help us hit our 1,000-donation goal. This is an inflection point in the fight for our Washington state values, and we can't afford to spend the next few months on the sidelines.

body:
Republican Voters,

We wanted to share with you that the Shelby County Board of Elections is in search of a full-time Republican Deputy Director. If you, or anyone you know of is interested, please have them reach out to the Board of Elections office by December 12th. The necessary information is attached.

Best regards,
Shelby County Republican Party

Hey Peter, I hope you enjoyed your Thanksgiving holiday. I spent some time reflecting on how thankful I am to be able to serve the people of Illinois’ 17th District in Congress. I’m reaching out today because my first end-of-month fundraising deadline as a Congressman-elect is coming up tomorrow. Here are a few reasons why it’s important:

The most important thing that we can do for our country in the near term
is to help Sen. Raphael Warnock win re-election.

Should he win his runoff race against Herschel Walker in Georgia, Warnock
will give those who believe in the core values of our country, including
voting rights, reproductive freedom and free and fair elections, a 51st
vote in a closely divided Senate.

That means that Trump Republicans will be stymied in their attempts to
subvert our constitution and undermine our democracy. But it also means
that no one Democratic senator — whether it’s Joe Manchin or Kyrsten
Sinema or anyone else — will be able to bring our government to a
standstill until their parochial or personal demands are met.

Re-electing Sen. Warnock means we have a better chance to hold the line on
those issues that are most important to us, and potentially make progress
as majorities in the House of Representatives change in future elections.

That’s the near term. Over the long term, we must continue to increase
registration and engagement with prospective voters who have been left out
of most Democratic campaigns’ outreach plans and budgets. These
under-invested voters are critical to future victories — in Texas,
Georgia, and throughout the country. Powered by People will continue to
focus on registering and engaging with them in the Lone Star State with
your help.

name: Tom Brejcha
subject: I won't sugarcoat it
body:
Dear Peter, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he's been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992250:JwdAtlGhN:m:1:3369487795:0BE4BB4AE869B902919FE4B01D838EA6:r)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now Vice-President Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992250:JwdAtlGhN:m:1:3369487795:0BE4BB4AE869B902919FE4B01D838EA6:r)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992250:JwdAtlGhN:m:1:3369487795:0BE4BB4AE869B902919FE4B01D838EA6:r)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood's nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We're fighting back, but we'll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment, they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992250:JwdAtlGhN:m:1:3369487795:0BE4BB4AE869B902919FE4B01D838EA6:r)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate to stand with David Daleiden today.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992250:JwdAtlGhN:m:1:3369487795:0BE4BB4AE869B902919FE4B01D838EA6:r)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel P.S. Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. Can I count on you to support the official criminal defense of David Daleiden? **[David is a pro-life hero. Will you make a generous donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to stop this attempt to crush him?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992250:JwdAtlGhN:m:1:3369487795:0BE4BB4AE869B902919FE4B01D838EA6:r)** [**DONATE**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992250:JwdAtlGhN:m:1:3369487795:0BE4BB4AE869B902919FE4B01D838EA6:r) [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992250:JwdAtlGhN:m:1:3369487795:0BE4BB4AE869B902919FE4B01D838EA6:r) The Thomas More Society is a not-for-profit, national public interest law firm dedicated to restoring respect in law for life, family, and religious liberty. [Please consider supporting our efforts with a generous, tax-deductible donation.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992250:JwdAtlGhN:m:1:3369487795:0BE4BB4AE869B902919FE4B01D838EA6:r) (C) Thomas More Society | [www.thomasmoresociety.org](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992251:JwdAtlGhN:m:1:3369487795:0BE4BB4AE869B902919FE4B01D838EA6:r)

name: Tom Brejcha
subject: He deserved a Pulitzer, instead he was charged with 9 felonies
body:
Dear Peter, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he's been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992368:J17w_lGNw:m:1:3371812801:17ECEC34F8EA3712328FEC88566BC028:r)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now Vice-President Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992368:J17w_lGNw:m:1:3371812801:17ECEC34F8EA3712328FEC88566BC028:r)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992368:J17w_lGNw:m:1:3371812801:17ECEC34F8EA3712328FEC88566BC028:r)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood's nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We're fighting back, but we'll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment, they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992368:J17w_lGNw:m:1:3371812801:17ECEC34F8EA3712328FEC88566BC028:r)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate to stand with David Daleiden today.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992368:J17w_lGNw:m:1:3371812801:17ECEC34F8EA3712328FEC88566BC028:r)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel P.S. Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. Can I count on you to support the official criminal defense of David Daleiden? **[David is a pro-life hero. Will you make a generous donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to stop this attempt to crush him?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992368:J17w_lGNw:m:1:3371812801:17ECEC34F8EA3712328FEC88566BC028:r)** [**DONATE**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992368:J17w_lGNw:m:1:3371812801:17ECEC34F8EA3712328FEC88566BC028:r) [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992368:J17w_lGNw:m:1:3371812801:17ECEC34F8EA3712328FEC88566BC028:r) The Thomas More Society is a not-for-profit, national public interest law firm dedicated to restoring respect in law for life, family, and religious liberty. [Please consider supporting our efforts with a generous, tax-deductible donation.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992368:J17w_lGNw:m:1:3371812801:17ECEC34F8EA3712328FEC88566BC028:r) (C) Thomas More Society | [www.thomasmoresociety.org](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992369:J17w_lGNw:m:1:3371812801:17ECEC34F8EA3712328FEC88566BC028:r)

Peter, I didn’t grow up with power or privilege.

Opportunities seldom fell into my lap. I had to fight tirelessly for every single office I’ve had the honor to serve in – from my very first term as city council member to my historic second term as state attorney general.

But I have to say, building opportunities for myself in a world that wasn’t designed to welcome me has only sharpened my resolve to make the path more accessible for the millions of other New Yorkers who continue to face the same barriers to success that I did decades ago. **That’s why I’m entirely committed to the fight for equality and progress – and now, you can support my fight too.**

**[Peter, today I’m kicking off my first end-of-month fundraising goal since our historic re-election, and I’m counting on you to chip in now to keep our momentum going strong. Will you donate $15 or more now to join my fight for justice?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/55346330/381451093/379053316?amounts=15,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk910-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzQwN2NjZC0wYjcxLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDBkM2E5ZWI0NzQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Fu-UHc936ZvMaZTGWDu7NttRhKRzWNXBGuCS8oQwyBc=)**

Peter, because of _your_ unyielding support, I was able to make history as the first Black woman ever to be re-elected as New York’s attorney general – **but the fight doesn’t end there****.** As I look toward my second term as AG, I have to be honest about the work that still needs to be done.

Right now, nearly 22 million people have lost their reproductive rights in states where abortion is either banned or extremely limited, the LGBTQ+ community is facing an increase in violent rhetoric and attacks – including the latest tragedies in Colorado Springs – and the richest people and corporations in our nation continue to get richer at the expense of working families.

name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: Giving Tuesday Deadline Extended
body:
__We need 500 supporters to reach our goal, but we 're not there yet. |
---

| I'll keep this brief, Peter --

For Giving Tuesday, a major donor had offered to pitch in $100,000 -- but only if 500 grassroots donors also pitched in as well. Last night, we came up _just_ a little short.

**But there 's some good news: **we just got approved for a one-day extension of our $100,000 match opportunity. We're only 48 donors away from securing this critical support -- can you get us over the finish line?

[Please, if you're able to, take advantage of this extension and give a special Giving Tuesday gift to LCV before the midnight deadline >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/pNy7f7wL_)

**REMEMBER:** if you begin a monthly donation -- even if it's as little as $5 we get to count it 12 times. This will have such a huge impact on the campaigns we can run going into the new year. We only need a few more people to hit our goal at this point -- but it will make a HUGE difference on what we can fund in the coming year.

Thank you for everything that you do to help build a healthier, safer, and more just future for all.

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters |

* * *

---

[](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/mkyVH2b_)
|
Dear Peter,

**Last week, we shared the news that if we can secure 500 donors by midnight this Giving Tuesday (tonight!) -- we'll secure a $100,000 match grant from a major donor.**

That's a huge goal. But there's a bit of a loophole: if you begin a monthly donation -- even if it's as little as $5 -- we get to count it 12 times.

[This $100,000 grant is not an opportunity we can miss out on. Please make your Giving Tuesday contribution to LCV today -- we cannot afford to come up short >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/pNy7f7wL_) |
---
**[**DONATE TODAY**](https://links.messages.lcv.)**

Peter -- we know that when the environmental movement turns out, we win. We saw it with the Green Wave during these midterms -- and now we need to translate that election victory into BIG wins for the environment.

Here are just a few reasons why your Giving Tuesday gift is EXTRA important right now, Peter:
1. **Right now, we 're urging President Biden to take decisive executive action on climate change.** With a strong mandate after this election, Biden has the power to declare a climate emergency to unlock federal funding to address the climate crisis, support clean energy solutions, and advance environmental justice. But that's ONLY going to happen if the environmental movement campaigns for it NOW.
2. **We have to stop the Willow Project, and we have to stop it NOW.** If this massive drilling project is allowed to move forward in Alaska and across the country, it would be the largest oil extraction project on federal land -- _equivalent to one year of carbon emissions from 76 coal plants_. We're working with partners in Alaska to help stop this project before it begins -- but how far we can go is going to come down to support from members like you.
3. **We stand for environmental justice.** With the growing threats of climate change and voter suppression, we stand up against the environmental issues that impact us all by making our voices heard by policymakers and encouraging a healthier, more sustainable future with critical investments in renewable energy, cleaner transportation, and air quality monitoring in vulnerable communities.

Bottom line, meeting our Giving Tuesday goal _matters_ , Peter. I hope you'll pitch in: [Our match unlock goal is 500 donors, but it ends at midnight tonight >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)
[](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/mkyVH2b_)
Remember, if you begin a monthly donation today, we get to count it 12 times toward our 500 donor goal.

Thank you for your continued support in the fight against climate change.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters

---

name: Katie Porter
subject: Child care 💰
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Congress
body:
Whether you have kids or not, it’s an issue you should care about.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/12?t=1&akid=15511%2E3422442%2EJnyGN6)
While millions of parents worry about how they’ll afford child care, it’s a problem we don’t talk about often enough in Washington.
In recent years the cost of child care has skyrocketed, **increasing by 40% during the pandemic** , outpacing the cost increase of things like housing and healthcare.
I’ve experienced this personally. As a single working parent, I was thrilled when I found out that my former employer, UC Irvine, offered child care on campus. **But I was shocked that for just my daughter Betsy, the cost was more than undergraduate tuition.**
Whether you have kids or not, it’s an issue you should care about. **We can’t have a strong, stable, globally competitive economy if families are weighed down by the cost of child care or parents can’t afford to work outside of the home.**
Last year I led the fight to cap child care spending at 7% of a family’s income. And while that didn’t become law, I’ll keep fighting to address our country’s child care crisis and lower costs for families. **[If the high cost of child care has affected you or your family, send me a note, I’d love to hear from you.](https://act.katieporter.com/survey/kpem-child-care-stories/?t=2&akid=15511%2E3422442%2EJnyGN6)**
