name: Tom Brejcha
subject: Peter, help David Daleiden
body:
Dear Peter, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he's been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992286:J0LKFlGxN:m:1:3371220873:3FC4617F8D6BA8557F3A303E66E24C70:r)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now Vice-President Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992286:J0LKFlGxN:m:1:3371220873:3FC4617F8D6BA8557F3A303E66E24C70:r)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992286:J0LKFlGxN:m:1:3371220873:3FC4617F8D6BA8557F3A303E66E24C70:r)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood's nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We're fighting back, but we'll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment, they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992286:J0LKFlGxN:m:1:3371220873:3FC4617F8D6BA8557F3A303E66E24C70:r)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate to stand with David Daleiden today.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992286:J0LKFlGxN:m:1:3371220873:3FC4617F8D6BA8557F3A303E66E24C70:r)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel P.S. Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. Can I count on you to support the official criminal defense of David Daleiden? **[David is a pro-life hero. Will you make a generous donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to stop this attempt to crush him?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992286:J0LKFlGxN:m:1:3371220873:3FC4617F8D6BA8557F3A303E66E24C70:r)** [**DONATE**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992286:J0LKFlGxN:m:1:3371220873:3FC4617F8D6BA8557F3A303E66E24C70:r) [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992286:J0LKFlGxN:m:1:3371220873:3FC4617F8D6BA8557F3A303E66E24C70:r) The Thomas More Society is a not-for-profit, national public interest law firm dedicated to restoring respect in law for life, family, and religious liberty. [Please consider supporting our efforts with a generous, tax-deductible donation.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992286:J0LKFlGxN:m:1:3371220873:3FC4617F8D6BA8557F3A303E66E24C70:r) (C) Thomas More Society | [www.thomasmoresociety.org](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61992287:J0LKFlGxN:m:1:3371220873:3FC4617F8D6BA8557F3A303E66E24C70:r)

Beyond that, we saw voters double down on protecting and strengthening democracy. Voters in Arizona rejected a stricter voter ID law. Voters in Connecticut approved early voting. Voters in places like Arkansas rejected attempts to make it harder to pass ballot initiatives. Voters in Michigan approved a constitutional amendment to protect the fundamental right to vote and expand access to voting.

In more than a dozen states, election deniers were on the ballot for key positions like in Governor or Secretary of State. In every one of those races called so far, voters rejected these dangerous candidates. And our nation is better for it.

Voters want fair elections and a voice in the process. Plain and simple.

But while the impact of fair maps is undeniable -- states with fair maps stand in stark contrast with gerrymandered states like Florida, Georgia, Wisconsin, Ohio and Texas where democracy remains at risk.

Voters in these states want fair elections too. But as long as gerrymandered state legislatures call the shots, they will continue to stack the deck against voters in their states -- using unconstitutional maps and extreme voter suppression tactics to ensure their reelection. We need to break this cycle.

clean_body: | Friend -- As the final midterm election ballots are counted, the impact of our movement for fair maps is undeniable. Because of the presence of more fair maps, voters were able to have their voices truly heard. = = This election proved that when voters cast their ballots on the fairer maps, the results can break through conventional midterm election trends that stood strong for decades. Beyond that, we saw voters double down on protecting and strengthening democracy. Voters in Arizona rejected a stricter voter ID law. Voters in Connecticut approved early voting. Voters in places like Arkansas rejected attempts to make it harder to pass ballot initiatives. Voters in Michigan approved a constitutional amendment to protect the fundamental right to vote and expand access to voting. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = In more than a dozen states, election deniers were on the ballot for key positions like in Governor or Secretary of State. In every one of those races called so far, voters rejected these dangerous candidates. And our nation is better for it. Voters want fair elections and a voice in the process. Plain and simple. But while the impact of fair maps is undeniable -- states with fair maps stand in stark contrast with gerrymandered states like Florida, Georgia, Wisconsin, Ohio and Texas where democracy remains at risk. Voters in these states want fair elections too. But as long as gerrymandered state legislatures call the shots, they will continue to stack the deck against voters in their states -- using unconstitutional maps and extreme voter suppression tactics to ensure their reelection. We need to break this cycle. = \-- A.G. Holder All On The Line is the grassroots advocacy campaign supported by the National Redistricting Action Fund. Support our work to end gerrymandering. name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: Democracy survives, truth prevails
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
Friend,
On Monday, the Board of State Canvassers certified the results of the November 8th general election in Michigan, which included my own re-election as Secretary of State. I know I speak for all of my colleagues who were elected earlier this month when I say that it is a great privilege to serve the people of Michigan. For me, personally, it will be an honor to continue defending the principles of free and fair elections as Secretary of State.
With Monday's vote, it is clear that democracy and truth prevailed yet again. Indeed, voters rejected election denialism so strongly in Michigan that the Democratic Party regained control of the State House and State Senate for the first time in decades. This opens up the path for numerous new opportunities to continue ensuring every voice is heard in our state, and I’m thrilled to work with legislative leadership who share our values in the years ahead.
And Michigan wasn't the only state that defended democracy. Election deniers lost their races in key states all across the country. The country-wide movement of election conspiracy theorists has been firmly rejected by the voters and our election system is well-positioned to handle the next election.
Together, we proved that democracy is alive and well, and that election denialism in our country is a losing political strategy.
But now is not the time to rest on our laurels. Because our work is not yet done . There is still a well-funded movement of anti-democratic extremists who are looking to undermine the integrity of our elections. In fact, the biggest, most well-known election denier of them all has announced he’s running for president - again.
But we can continue to win if we stay in the fight. And I am staying in the fight. In fact, here’s my pledge : I will do everything in my power to protect democracy and will speak out against anyone who spreads lies about the sanctity of our elections, in Michigan and across the country. That means continuing to be a leader of the non-partisan, national pro-democracy movement . And supporting candidates who are fighting their own election extremist opponents.
But I’m going to need your help. Will you pledge to stand with me over the next four years as we grow our pro-democracy coalition and defeat those who seek to challenge the integrity of our elections? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/gP2_tNulq0eyvG2x5_CDNg2]
https://secure.ngpvan.com/gP2_tNulq0eyvG2x5_CDNg2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/gP2_tNulq0eyvG2x5_CDNg2]Thank you for being with me throughout this campaign. I look forward to continuing our journey together.
Onward,
Jocelyn

This opens up the path for numerous new opportunities to continue ensuring every voice is heard in our state, and I’m thrilled to work with legislative leadership who share our values in the years ahead. And Michigan wasn't the only state that defended democracy. Election deniers lost their races in key states all across the country. The country-wide movement of election conspiracy theorists has been firmly rejected by the voters and our election system is well-positioned to handle the next election. Together, we proved that democracy is alive and well, and that election denialism in our country is a losing political strategy. But now is not the time to rest on our laurels. Because our work is not yet done . There is still a well-funded movement of anti-democratic extremists who are looking to undermine the integrity of our elections. In fact, the biggest, most well-known election denier of them all has announced he’s running for president - again. But we can continue to win if we stay in the fight. And I am staying in the fight. In fact, here’s my pledge : I will do everything in my power to protect democracy and will speak out against anyone who spreads lies about the sanctity of our elections, in Michigan and across the country. That means continuing to be a leader of the non-partisan, national pro-democracy movement . And supporting candidates who are fighting their own election extremist opponents. But I’m going to need your help. Will you pledge to stand with me over the next four years as we grow our pro-democracy coalition and defeat those who seek to challenge the integrity of our elections? [] [ you for being with me throughout this campaign. I look forward to continuing our journey together. Onward, Jocelyn [] This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Fellow American,

By now you know Herschel Walker is in the fight of his life. He's gearing up to face off against the socialist Democrat, Raphael Warnock, in a December 6th Senate runoff that will determine the extent to which Democrats have control over the Senate.

I think a lot of folks, yourself included perhaps, may be thinking that this race isn't important given that Democrats have 50 votes plus Kamala Harris' tie-breaking vote - effectively giving them control of the Senate. If you're in this mindset, then you're the audience I'm hoping to reach today. This race isn't over, and it would be extremely bad form to leave Herschel Walker on the field, alone, in the final hours of his race.

Disclaimer: **[At the end of this email, I'm going to ask you to chip-in $5 to help keep Herschel's campaign funded through December 6th.](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=4917420072b64ea09329b2e7d3f009b1&_e=sOqQ2SHPi-AeMl2hX97HCnHzDCpF2ApmcIYj86673cBQqIR5GzJBGeccnK3SMiYjnV05dHtNghoz1dlgvh7lgcqWiVfj16pwlfcXsZrUoaoZ_fm0u4wfOCrYEumxKMXFCfJa8cxo-4nFWPU-SvPK-Y0tm5tkgqH0gvp1p_eN3ro3SD9GLCkF2HENzA_Rg5FFi1ORsb_zFSSQsQ3jN4YhMHK6mEeN07Do340BMNTr6CT6eBBGlfk-omB8afSy7GLJIjLMVHrIr5lBvc5YlNm5HRrrNajU1otfz_QUAfkd0KJ_Rz_seoXBkI1Jd3bZI_Vmz4xzUNQfGGuHPEPOlKxj1m6IcQwYk2SDcyCEV_q6bsr9HkVt1BRKc1wtcvqd_TxAphK0ikEfxaTXrPCouwMCGXoZD8nHjtyNpq0tpjk7KidPF7YN9qxRfQ8Do08hOYBMoFmLMZc4q1NGPt8QH8AfVw%3D%3D)** But first, I'm going to give you five reasons why your donation is needed now more than ever.
1. **_Absences_** : Absences in the Senate happen from time to time, due to health reasons or otherwise. If we can get Herschel elected, Republicans and Dems will each have 50 seats - leaving Democrats with no margin for error. If a Democrat is out sick with the flu and cannot vote, Dems cannot pass legislation. **If Herschel loses, Dems have a cushion.**
2. **_2024_** : The 2024 map for Democrats is tough. If Herschel wins on December 6th, Republicans start the 2024 cycle from a position of strength. If we have 50 seats going into 2024, we can devote even more resources to West Virginia and Montana (**both deep red states**) where Democrat senators will be seeking reelection.

[** CHIP in $5 ->**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=4917420072b64ea09329b2e7d3f009b1&_e=sOqQ2SHPi-AeMl2hX97HCnHzDCpF2ApmcIYj86673cBQqIR5GzJBGeccnK3SMiYjnV05dHtNghoz1dlgvh7lgcqWiVfj16pwlfcXsZrUoaoZ_fm0u4wfOCrYEumxKMXFCfJa8cxo-4nFWPU-SvPK-Y0tm5tkgqH0gvp1p_eN3ro3SD9GLCkF2HENzA_Rg5FFi1ORsb_zFSSQsQ3jN4YhMHK6mEeN07Do340BMNTr6CT6eBBGlfk-omB8afSy7GLJIjLMVHrIr5lBvc5YlNm5HahresHS9b_h1ZCyV1prwk2J8eYMFVuBuwQZ9A3rv6eIJqA4yyF7KkWr5u4XW2kPWLV9T4fHkk_9suz5u9Fp24mU1gSEbHL15GjHjFh808NAy2l5-s8ZpKYEwTzPVJxOjLAWf9dvd4gty74TCDYlM3vE1THN6Tbw9D9bTSP3bfy1LW-pIECAtJIvXgbV__zzVA%3D%3D)

3. **_Judges_** : With a 50/50 Senate, the Senate Judiciary Committee will have equal numbers of Republicans and Democrats - allowing us to force Democrats to only consider the most consequential nominations. **If Warnock wins, Democrats can confirm anyone they want.**
4. **_Federal nominations:_** With a 50/50 Senate, Republicans will have leverage over who can win confirmation to lead federal agencies. With a 50/50 Senate, we'll get less Elizabeth Warren-type nominees and more “level-headed” options to give the thumbs up or thumbs down to.
5. **_6 years:_** If Herschel Walker wins on December 6th, he'll serve for the next 6 years. You need him so we can keep America great. | Fellow American, By now you know Herschel Walker is in the fight of his life. He's gearing up to face off against the socialist Democrat, Raphael Warnock, in a December 6th Senate runoff that will determine the extent to which Democrats have control over the Senate. I think a lot of folks, yourself included perhaps, may be thinking that this race isn't important given that Democrats have 50 votes plus Kamala Harris' tie-breaking vote - effectively giving them control of the Senate. If you're in this mindset, then you're the audience I'm hoping to reach today. This race isn't over, and it would be extremely bad form to leave Herschel Walker on the field, alone, in the final hours of his race. Disclaimer: But first, I'm going to give you five reasons why your donation is needed now more than ever. 1. Absences : Absences in the Senate happen from time to time, due to health reasons or otherwise. If we can get Herschel elected, Republicans and Dems will each have 50 seats - leaving Democrats with no margin for error. If a Democrat is out sick with the flu and cannot vote, Dems cannot pass legislation. If Herschel loses, Dems have a cushion. 2. 2024 : The 2024 map for Democrats is tough. If Herschel wins on December 6th, Republicans start the 2024 cycle from a position of strength. If we have 50 seats going into 2024, we can devote even more resources to West Virginia and Montana (both deep red states) where Democrat senators will be seeking reelection. 3. Judges : With a 50/50 Senate, the Senate Judiciary Committee will have equal numbers of Republicans and Democrats - allowing us to force Democrats to only consider the most consequential nominations. If Warnock wins, Democrats can confirm anyone they want. 4. Federal nominations: With a 50/50 Senate, Republicans will have leverage over who can win confirmation to lead federal agencies. With a 50/50 Senate, we'll get less Elizabeth Warren-type nominees and more “level-headed” options to give the thumbs up or thumbs down to. 5. 6 years: If Herschel Walker wins on December 6th, he'll serve for the next 6 years. name: Peter Welch
subject: Can you complete our new Senate Strategy Survey?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
This is important.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1214%2E61531%2EqGQfCx)
Team,
I ran for the U.S. Senate to represent the people of Vermont — not the special interests or corporate PACs or the well-connected.
And thanks to this incredible grassroots team, we won, and I’ll be sworn into the Senate early next year!
But our work is just beginning. Democrats have held on to our majority in the Senate, and I’m ready to fight for progressive values, protect reproductive health, address climate change, and so much more. Because I work for you.
**So today, I want to hear from you. I want to hear what’s most important to you, and what you think I should focus on. Because I’m going to be a people-powered Senator, and want to maximize every opportunity I can to make progress for you.**
[**Can you take just a couple of minutes and complete our new Senate Strategy Survey?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/survey/em-senate-strategy-survey?source=em_20221130_s_p_survey&t=3&akid=1214%2E61531%2EqGQfCx)
[TAKE THE SURVEY](https://act.welchforvermont.com/survey/em-senate-strategy-survey?source=em_20221130_s_p_survey&t=7&t=8&akid=1214%2E61531%2EqGQfCx)
---
I’m looking forward to reading through the responses to hear about the issues that matter the most to you, where you get your news from, and more.
I promise that as a Senator, I will listen before I act. Because I wouldn’t be here without all the amazing folks like you who supported our campaign.
Now that Republicans have won a majority in the House, and we have a divided Congress, the future of our progressive agenda is less certain — but I know progress is possible if we stay focused. I’ve reached across the aisle to pass legislation in the House, and I’ll continue doing it in the Senate to benefit Vermonters.
**I work for you and will fight for you in the Senate — so I’m hoping to hear from you first.**
[**Please complete our Senate Strategy Survey. I’m counting on your input, so it would really mean a lot.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/survey/em-senate-strategy-survey?source=em_20221130_s_p_survey&t=4&akid=1214%2E61531%2EqGQfCx)
Thanks so much for all your support. I’m looking forward to everything we can accomplish to help Vermonters and protect our democracy.
Peter Welch

---

body:
Georgians are casting their ballots and we need all hands on deck to pull ahead and keep Georgia blue.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221130-3666-header&t=1&akid=3666%2E2526796%2ECP_edi)
Our battleground race just shifted into new territory, and I urgently need folks like you by my side to keep up the fight. **Here's why:**
* FIRST, right-wing super PACs flooded tens of millions of dollars into Georgia to help my opponent, Herschel Walker, win.

* BUT THEN, our people-powered movement fought back against this unprecedented spending and forced our race into a runoff election.

* **NOW, Georgians are casting their ballots and we need all hands on deck to pull ahead and keep Georgia blue. We're looking for 538 more folks to give before our crucial 11:59 p.m. deadline, but time is running out, and we're falling short.**

So much is at stake. We got to this point without taking a cent from corporate PACs, and I'm determined to continue this fight the grassroots way. That's why I'm counting on you to pitch in whatever you can at this critical moment.
[Please, will you rush a donation of $6 or more right now to split between me and AOC so we can defeat Walker and keep Georgia blue?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221130-2.-VXtt9&refcode=em20221130-3666-P_FND_ANO_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3666%2E2526796%2ECP_edi)

clean_body: With my runoff election just six days away -- and our end-of-month deadline tonight -- our work to expand our Senate majority hangs in the balance. | | Derek, I'm no political insider or career politician. I'm the son of a Georgia preacher who's committed my life to service. I'm ready to keep up our critical fights for justice in Washington, from protecting voting rights to restoring reproductive freedom -- but I can't do it alone. With my runoff election just six days away -- and our end-of-month deadline tonight -- our work to expand our Senate majority hangs in the balance. Mitch McConnell and his extreme Republican allies are turning all of their efforts and money toward this election. It’s going to be tough, but I know this team can get the job done. Will you split a $10 donation between my campaign and the DNC ahead of tonight's fundraising deadline and next week’s runoff election? Since we launched this campaign, the GOP and outside groups have been pouring money into attack ads to oppose our people-powered movement. It’s no surprise; last year’s runoff elections were some of the most expensive Senate races in history. But the GOP is willing to spend whatever it takes to defeat me and prevent Democrats from expanding the Senate majority, so I’m a little worried. This runoff election is going to be close and our critical fight for justice isn’t over. I'm once again counting on grassroots supporters like you to power this movement to victory: Thank you for your support and everything you do. Raphael Sen. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

From Day One, we’ve been up against the political machine. In five years,
we’ve challenged decades-long incumbents, Democratic leadership, and
right-wing Super PACs — and we’ve won.

In order to keep winning, we need to raise funds year-round to continue
recruiting, training, and electing new Justice Democrats for every
election cycle. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/122186?refcode=em20221130-26329&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=26329%2E1203867%2Eqt8m4h ]Your support is critical for us as we prepare for
candidate recruitment, so we’re asking: can you dig deep and help us reach
our $110,000 goal by midnight?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/122186?refcode=em20221130-26329&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=26329%2E1203867%2Eqt8m4h ]Contribute $3

Even though we just helped elect Summer Lee and Greg Casar, we saw the
cost. AIPAC spent millions upon millions of dollars to try to keep Summer
from winning and hand her seat to an extremist Republican.

Right-wing super PACs like AIPAC want to keep us out because we threaten
their system of profit and power. Because when our candidates join the
Squad, they fight for a Congress that actually works for us.

We can’t forget that those in our government are the oldest in American
history. The average representative in the House is 58 years old, and
almost a quarter of Congress is over 70 years old — even though
millennials are the largest adult population in the country.

That’s why our Justice Democrats are on the frontlines — on the campaign
trail and in the halls of Congress. They represent a shock to the system,
and right-wing groups like AIPAC will attack relentlessly to try to take
our movement down.

To recruit and elect more people-powered candidates, we have to be
prepared for everything that the right and the political establishment
will throw at us. That can only happen with your support, so we’re hoping
you’ll rush a donation right now.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/122186?refcode=em20221130-26329&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=26329%2E1203867%2Eqt8m4h ]We need to reach our $110,000 goal by midnight. Can we count on you to
help us fight off groups like AIPAC and elect more Justice Democrats?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/122186?refcode=em20221130-26329&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=26329%2E1203867%2Eqt8m4h ]Contribute

In solidarity,

Team JD

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1005&akid=26329%2E1203867%2Eqt8m4h ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1006&akid=26329%2E1203867%2Eqt8m4h ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: Gabby Giffords still works hard for all of us, fighting to stop the flow of firearms into the hands of dangerous men. When will Congress join her in saying that there have been enough of these shootings? We don’t know how long it will take, but we can help her in the good fight.

no more shootings

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tadb886be-90b9-4047-a859-9c62f17d74e4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

| | | | | Peter, | _I am so damn tired of seeing places like Colorado Springs or Chesapeake, VA start to trend on social media as a sick, sinking feeling starts to form in the pit of my stomach. Followed by my clicking on a story only to have my worst fears realized--we've had our latest Newtown. Tucson. Santa Barbara. Parkland. Orlando. Dayton. El Paso. Tree of Life. Fort Hood. Mandalay Bay. The list is as endless as it is heartbreaking. _ **It. Must. Stop.** **_This past year, for the first time in 30 years, Congress acted on gun violence._ **No, we didn't come close to getting everything we need. Yet, that Republicans felt pressured into addressing long-term priorities of the gun violence prevention movement--including a national gun trafficking law and closing the "boyfriend" loophole, which had allowed many violent men to continue to legally purchase firearms--was still a huge step forward. _This happened largely because of _Giffords_. _Giffords_ was founded because of the terrible tragedy that befell then-Rep. Gabby Giffords, who while holding a town hall meeting in her Tucson, AZ district was shot through the head and nearly died._ **_[The tragedy led Gabby and her husband--recently re-elected Senator Mark Kelly--to devote their lives to solving the problem of out-of-control gun violence in America, and your support today can help them take this fight to the next level, for all of us _._](https://default.salsalabs.org/T38ea2867-bc20-4173-8561-fa5163287781/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_**

---
| | _Giffords has been a leader in this fight, helping pass not just the national legislation, but guiding President Biden's many executive orders to fight gun violence and helping pass groundbreaking gun laws in states around the country from California to Virginia, Vermont to New Mexico._ **_Yet, the gun violence of the past few weeks reminds us that as much as we've done, there is still so much left to do. We shouldn't have to live in a country where we worry when our kids leave for school in the morning or we look around for the nearest exits when we walk into a mall or movie theater. It is despicable, really._** _So while this issue is on our minds--knowing it's only a matter of time until the next one and the one after that_ , unless and until we have passed universal background checks, universal red flag laws, an assault weapons ban, a high capacity magazine ban and more--[_**would you please join us this holiday season in saying ENOUGH, and giving a donation of $10, $20 or whatever you can, to Giffords as this incredible organization fights to make the lives of our families safer?**_](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9a80272e-7e7c-43ab-b75c-254e62b67ddd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) This holiday season let's all hope for a country free of the scourge of preventable gun violence.

When the city found glaring disparities in access to capital for our minority and women-owned small businesses, I helped form the Business Ecosystem Alliance for Minorities and Women to remove these barriers. As a native Houstonian and former At-Large City Council Member, I know firsthand the challenges facing our city. By working together, we can elect a leader who will spend every waking moment depositing into our communities and working to make Houston the best it can be. This election year is our chance to change Houston’s trajectory for the better.
